words.defJa: モデルの学習に使われる事例や情報の集まり

cards.ja: この前、会社で作った音声認識のモデルを実家の祖母に試してもらったら、学習データが東京の若い社員の声ばかりだったせいで、祖母の関西弁が全然聞き取れなかったんですよ。画面には意味の通らない文字が並んで、祖母に大笑いされました。最初はモデルの出来が悪いんだって思ったんですけど、聞いたこともない話し方なんて、人間だって聞き取れっこないですよね。帰り際に祖母から「この機械、東京の人の言葉しか分からへんのやな」って言われました。
cards.en: The other day I had my grandmother back home try a speech recognition model we built at work, and because the training data was nothing but the voices of young employees in Tokyo, it could not make out her Kansai dialect at all. Meaningless characters lined up on the screen, and my grandmother laughed out loud at me. At first I thought the model was just badly made, but, you know, even a human could never make out a way of speaking they have never once heard. As I was leaving, my grandmother said to me, "So this machine only understands the way Tokyo people talk."

words.defJa: 他と区別された個々の自己

cards.ja: 自己はただ一つだと不二一元論は説くが、歯が痛むのは私であって隣の人ではない以上、この痛みを感じている個我まで見かけにすぎないという主張は、にわかには受け入れがたい。シャンカラもこの実感を退けはしない。日常の水準では、人はそれぞれ別の身体と心を持ち、行為の結果も別々に受け取ると認めるからである。そのうえで彼の学派がよく用いるのが、水を張った器に映る太陽のたとえで、器の数だけ像はあっても、空の太陽は一つしかない。では、水が濁って像が曇ったと嘆いているのは、像なのか、太陽なのか。
cards.en: Advaita Vedanta teaches that the self is only one, but since it is I whose tooth aches and not the person next to me, the claim that even the individual self feeling this pain is no more than an appearance is hard to accept at once. Shankara, too, does not dismiss this felt sense. That is because he grants that, at the everyday level, people each have a separate body and mind and receive the results of their actions separately. On that basis, what his school often uses is the simile of the sun reflected in vessels filled with water: there may be as many images as there are vessels, yet there is only one sun in the sky. Then who is it that laments that the water has turned muddy and the image has clouded over, the image or the sun?

words.defJa: 入力の各部分の関連に応じて情報を重み付けする仕組み

cards.ja: 「トロフィーがスーツケースに入らないのは、それが大きすぎるからだ」という文を見て、「それ」はスーツケースではなくトロフィーを指していると、人は迷うことなく判断します。言語モデルは、これに近いことを計算で行います。「それ」という語を処理するとき、文中のほかの語一つ一つとの関連の強さを数値で求めるのです。関連が強い語には大きな重みが付き、その語の情報が多く取り込まれます。語と語の関連に応じてこのように重みを割り当てる注意機構は、二〇一七年に発表されたトランスフォーマーという設計の中心に据えられました。
cards.en: Seeing the sentence "The trophy does not fit in the suitcase because it is too big," people judge without hesitation that "it" refers to the trophy and not the suitcase. A language model does something close to this by calculation. When it processes the word "it," it works out as a number the strength of the relation to each of the other words in the sentence. Words that are strongly related receive large weights, and more of their information is taken in. The attention mechanism, which assigns weights in this way according to the relations between words, was placed at the center of the design called the Transformer, published in 2017.

words.reading: しょうめいかのうせい
words.defJa: 定めた公理と規則から結論を導けること

cards.ja: 一九三一年、二十代半ばのゲーデルは、命題の証明可能性そのものを数の性質として扱うという方法で、当時の数学界の常識を覆す定理を発表した。計算機が文字を数で表すように記号の列に番号を振れば、「この命題は証明できる」という主張も数についての主張に変わる。そこで彼は算術の体系の中に、自分自身は証明できないと述べる文を組み立てた。この体系に矛盾がない限り、その文は証明できず、したがって述べている内容は正しい。正しいのに、体系の中でいくら推論を重ねても導けない命題が、こうして姿を現した。
cards.en: In 1931 Gödel, then in his mid-twenties, published a theorem that overturned the conventional wisdom of the mathematical world of the day, using a method that treated the provability of propositions itself as a property of numbers. If you assign numbers to strings of symbols, just as a computer represents characters as numbers, even the claim "this proposition can be proved" turns into a claim about numbers. He then constructed, within the system of arithmetic, a sentence stating that it itself cannot be proved. As long as this system contains no contradiction, that sentence cannot be proved, and therefore what it states is correct. Thus there appeared a proposition that is correct and yet cannot be derived however much reasoning is piled up within the system.

words.defJa: 欲望や対象への執着から離れること

cards.ja: 望むものを何でも与えると言われれば、たいていの人は富や長寿を挙げるだろうが、『カタ・ウパニシャッド』に登場する少年ナチケータスは、死の神ヤマが差し出したそれらをすべて断った。少年が知りたかったのは、人が死後どうなるかということだけだった。家畜も黄金も歌や踊りも永遠には続かず、どれほど長い寿命であれ短いものだ、と彼は答えた。神の誘いにも動じなかったこの態度は、ヴェーダーンタの伝統で、離欲の手本とされてきた。
cards.en: Told they would be given anything they wished for, most people would probably name wealth or long life, but the boy Nachiketas, who appears in the Katha Upanishad, refused every one of those things when Yama, the god of death, held them out to him. All the boy wanted to know was what becomes of a person after death. Cattle, gold, song and dance do not last forever, and however long a life may be, it is a short thing, he answered. This attitude, unshaken even by a god's enticement, has been regarded in the Vedanta tradition as a model of dispassion.

words.defJa: 積層構造などで高速な情報転送を図る記憶装置

cards.ja: メモリ半導体は長らく、市況の変動に業績が左右されやすい汎用品とみなされてきた。ところが、人工知能の学習や推論を担うサーバーの増加に伴って、米エヌビディアなどの画像処理半導体のすぐ隣に配置され、大量のデータを高速でやり取りできる特別な製品に注文が集中するようになった。鍵を握るのは積層技術だ。メモリチップを縦に何層も積み重ね、上下を貫く電極でつないだ広帯域メモリは、一度に送れるデータの量が従来品より格段に多い。製造が難しく、量産できる企業は世界でも数社に限られるため、各社は増産に向けた設備投資を急いでいる。
cards.en: Memory chips were long regarded as commodity products whose makers' earnings are easily swayed by market fluctuations. But as servers handling the training and inference of artificial intelligence multiplied, orders came to concentrate on a special product that is placed right beside the graphics processing chips of America's Nvidia and others and can exchange huge amounts of data at high speed. The key lies in stacking technology. High-bandwidth memory, in which memory chips are stacked vertically in many layers and connected by electrodes running through them from top to bottom, can send far more data at once than conventional products. Because it is hard to manufacture and only a handful of companies in the world can mass-produce it, each of them is rushing capital investment to expand output.

words.reading: ごさぎゃくでんぱほう
words.defJa: 出力側から各変数の誤差への影響を計算する方法

cards.ja: 誤差逆伝播法による学習は、まず間違えることから始まります。モデルに入力を与えて答えを出させ、正解とのずれを一つの数値にまとめたものが誤差です。次に、この誤差を出力層から入力層へ向かって逆向きにたどります。層を一つさかのぼるたびに、連鎖律という微分の規則を当てはめていきます。すると、膨大な数の重みの一つ一つについて、それを少し動かせば誤差がどれだけ増減するかがまとめて求まるので、その値に応じて重みをわずかに直してはまた答えを出させ、誤差を少しずつ小さくしていきます。
cards.en: Learning by backpropagation begins with getting things wrong. The model is given an input and made to produce an answer, and the gap between that answer and the correct one, gathered into a single number, is the error. Next, this error is traced backward from the output layer toward the input layer. Each time we go back one layer, we apply a rule of differentiation called the chain rule. This yields, all together and for each one of an enormous number of weights, how much the error would rise or fall if that weight were moved slightly, so we correct the weights a little according to those values, have the model answer again, and shrink the error bit by bit.

words.defJa: 衣服も所有しない男性修行者を理想とする一派

cards.ja: 二〇一八年二月、インド南部カルナータカ州にあるジャイナ教空衣派の聖地シュラヴァナベルゴラで、十二年に一度の大祭が営まれた。各地から集まった信者たちが見守る中、丘の上に立つ巨大な石像の頭から、牛乳などが次々と注がれた。像は聖者バーフバリを表しており、衣を一切身に着けていないその姿は、所有を捨てる誓いを徹底して、男性の出家者が衣服すら持たないことを理想とする同派の教えをそのまま体現している。僧が持ち歩くのは、孔雀の羽のほうきと水入れくらいだ。
cards.en: In February 2018, a great festival held once every twelve years took place at Shravanabelagola, a holy site of the Digambara Jain tradition in the southern Indian state of Karnataka. As believers gathered from many regions looked on, milk and other offerings were poured one after another over the head of the huge stone statue standing on the hill. The statue represents the saint Bahubali, and its figure, wearing nothing at all, directly embodies the teaching of this tradition, which pushes the vow of renouncing possessions to its limit and holds as its ideal that male renunciants own not even clothing. About all its monks carry with them is a peacock-feather whisk and a water pot.

words.defJa: 生き物が死と新たな生を繰り返すこと

cards.ja: 仏教は、変わることのない自己というものを認めない。では、死んだ後、来世に生まれてくるのはいったい何なのか。『ミリンダ王の問い』のなかで、移っていくものがないのに生まれ変わることがあるのかと王に問われた僧ナーガセーナは、灯火のたとえで答えている。ある灯火から別の灯火へ火を移しても、前の灯火がそのまま向こうへ渡ったわけではないが、後の火は前の火がなければともらなかったはずで、ここでは実体が運ばれることなく、原因と結果だけがつながっている。思えば、輪廻転生から抜け出した境地を指す「涅槃」という語も、もともとは火が吹き消された状態を意味していた。
cards.en: Buddhism does not accept any self that never changes. Then what exactly is it that is born into the next life after death? In The Questions of King Milinda, the monk Nagasena, asked by the king whether one can be reborn when there is nothing that passes across, answers with the simile of a lamp. When a flame is passed from one lamp to another, the first lamp has not itself crossed over, yet the later flame would never have been lit without the earlier one; here no substance is carried across, and only cause and effect are linked. Come to think of it, the word nirvana, which refers to the state of having escaped the cycle of rebirth, also originally meant the state of a fire that has been blown out.

words.defJa: 新しい技術によって生産や利用の仕方が変わること

cards.ja: 技術革新は天才のひらめきから生まれる、という物語は分かりやすい。しかし、半導体の歴史をたどると、様子はかなり違う。ひらめきは始まりにすぎない。最先端の回路を焼き付けるのに欠かせなくなった極端紫外線の露光技術が、その好例である。基礎的な実験が始まったのは一九八〇年代だが、光源の出力不足をはじめとする壁に何度も阻まれ、量産の工場で使われるようになったのは、三十年余りが過ぎた二〇一〇年代の終わりであった。
cards.en: The story that technological innovation is born from a genius's flash of insight is easy to follow. But if you trace the history of semiconductors, the picture is quite different. The flash of insight is no more than a beginning. Extreme ultraviolet lithography, which has become indispensable for printing the most advanced circuits, is a good example. Basic experiments began in the 1980s, but the work was blocked again and again by obstacles, starting with the light source's lack of output power, and it was the end of the 2010s, a little over thirty years later, before it came to be used in mass-production plants.

words.defJa: 純粋経験を論じた日本の近代哲学者

cards.ja: 京都の東山のふもとには、西田幾多郎が思索にふけりながら歩いたという水路沿いの小道が、「哲学の道」の名で残っている。最初の著書『善の研究』は、見る自分と見られる物とがまだ分かれていない経験を出発点としている。美しい音楽に心を奪われているとき、そこには聞く自分も聞かれる音もなく、ただ響きだけがあるのであって、主観と客観という区別は、後から振り返って付け加えたものにすぎないというのである。若いころの彼は、座禅に打ち込んでいた。金沢で同級生だった鈴木大拙が禅を英語で海外に紹介したのに対し、彼は西洋哲学の言葉で考え抜く道を選んだ。
cards.en: At the foot of Higashiyama in Kyoto, a canal-side path where Nishida Kitaro is said to have walked deep in thought survives under the name the Philosopher's Path. His first book, An Inquiry into the Good, takes as its starting point an experience in which the self that sees and the thing that is seen have not yet separated. When we are carried away by beautiful music, he says, there is neither a self that hears nor a sound that is heard but only the resonance, and the distinction between subject and object is nothing more than something added afterwards on looking back. As a young man, he was devoted to seated Zen meditation. While Suzuki Daisetsu, his classmate in Kanazawa, introduced Zen abroad in English, he chose the path of thinking things through in the language of Western philosophy.

words.defJa: 一覧の各項と異なるものを作って限界を示す方法

cards.ja: 対角線論法を使えば、どんなプログラムにも出力できない数列があることを示せます。まず、零と一を無限に出力し続けるプログラムをすべて集め、番号を付けて一覧にします。次に、その出力を上から順に並べた表の対角線に沿って、最初の数列からは先頭の数字、二番目の数列からは二つ目の数字というように拾っていき、零なら一、一なら零と、すべて逆にした新しい数列を作ります。この数列は、何番目のプログラムの出力と比べても、ちょうどその番号の位置で食い違うため、一覧にあるどのプログラムからも出てきません。
cards.en: With the diagonal argument, you can show that there are sequences no program can output. First, gather every program that keeps outputting zeros and ones forever, number them, and make a list. Next, lay their outputs out in a table from the top down and pick digits along its diagonal, the first digit from the first sequence, the second digit from the second sequence and so on, then make a new sequence by flipping them all, zero to one and one to zero. Whichever numbered program's output you compare it with, this sequence differs at exactly the position of that number, so it does not come out of any program on the list.

cards.en: Before it gives any account of how to sit or breathe, the root scripture of yoga, said to have been compiled by Patanjali, flatly declares that the aim is to bring the workings of the mind to a stop. At this stage, nothing about moving the body has come up anywhere yet. The path of practice is divided into eight stages, and placed first are restraints such as not harming living things and not telling lies. Posture appears third, and about the only condition given for it is that it be steady and comfortable. After that come regulation of the breath, control of the senses, concentration and meditation, and samadhi is placed last, as the eighth.

In 2018, GlobalFoundries of the United States announced that it would freeze development of its seven-nanometer generation manufacturing technology indefinitely. Advanced Micro Devices of the United States, a major customer, ended up entrusting all manufacturing of its products of this generation to the leading Taiwanese contract chipmaker.

cards.ja: まだ赤字の人工知能ベンチャーに高い株価が付いてるの、不思議に思いません？あれは、投資家が何年も先の利益まで見込んで値段を付けてるからなんですよ。ただ、十年後に入ってくる百億円は今の百億円と同じ価値じゃないので、金利を使って割引現在価値に直してから足し合わせるんです。だから金利次第で話が変わるんですよね。遠い将来の利益ほど大きく割り引かれて今の値打ちが小さくなるから、業績は全然変わってないのに、金利が上がっただけでこういう成長株が一斉に売られたりするんですよ。
cards.en: Don't you find it strange that AI start-ups still in the red command such high share prices? That is because investors set the price counting on profits many years ahead. But ten billion yen coming in ten years from now isn't worth the same as ten billion yen today, so you use the interest rate to convert it into a discounted present value before adding everything up. That's why the story changes depending on interest rates. The further off the profits are, the more heavily they are discounted and the smaller their worth today becomes, so even though nothing at all about the business has changed, growth stocks like these can be sold off all at once just because interest rates have gone up.

cards.en: Conversational AI sometimes cites, quite plausibly, papers that do not exist. A human who did the same would be called a liar, but the usual explanation is that the AI has no intention of deceiving anyone and is merely outputting a highly probable continuation based on the sequences of words it has learned. There is nothing wrong with this explanation. But what if a company keeps selling its product as it is, knowing that users trust an answer more when it is stated without hesitation, even if the answer is wrong? Even if the machine has no intention to deceive, is that not a deception practiced on its users?

cards.en: With memory chips, there was a time when the makers would not stop increasing output even though prices kept falling. It seems odd if you think about it in the ordinary way. If you alone cut production you lose market share, and although everyone knew that if they all kept producing, prices would collapse and all of them would end up in the red, whoever backed down first lost, so nobody could stop. It was exactly what game theory calls a "chicken game," and news reports of the time actually called it that. After all that, a number of companies dropped out, including Japan's Elpida Memory, and the few that survived now share the market among themselves.

Far from the workload going down, we now even have someone whose job is mostly fixing broken tests.

cards.en: No one can enter the production area of a semiconductor plant while wearing makeup. Workers change into special garments that cover the whole body. They put on gloves and a mask, and the inner door is designed not to open until they have stood in a strong blast of air in a small chamber called an air shower and blown off the dust on the surface of their clothing. This is because the circuit lines are far thinner than a human hair, and a single speck of dust too small to see can cause a defect. Inside the clean room, where clean air flows constantly from ceiling to floor, the biggest source of contamination is still the human being.

A leading American chipmaker brought out products for China with reduced performance, but the threshold was revised the following year and those too became subject to the regulations. The aim of the regulations lay not so much in individual products as in the very computational capacity that China could obtain.

words.defJa: 仏教で物事が最後まで徹底し完成すること

cards.ja: 悟りと聞くと、多くの人は山の頂のような終点を思い浮かべる。そこに着けば、もう歩く必要はないはずだ。だが、伝承によれば、釈迦は菩提樹の下で悟りを開いた後もそこにとどまることなく、亡くなるまで数十年にわたって各地を歩き、出会う人々に教えを説き続けた。行き着く先は山の頂ではなく、人々の中にあったことになる。空海の開いた真言宗がよりどころとする経典も、悟りを求める心を出発点とし、慈悲を根本とし、人々を救う手立てである方便を究竟とする、と説く。
cards.en: When they hear the word enlightenment, many people picture an end point like a mountain summit. Once you arrive there, there should be no further need to walk. But according to tradition, even after attaining enlightenment under the Bodhi tree, the Buddha did not remain there, but walked from place to place for several decades until his death and kept teaching the people he met. It follows that the destination lay not on the summit but among people. A scripture relied on by the Shingon school that Kukai founded likewise teaches that the mind seeking enlightenment is the starting point, compassion is the root, and skillful means, the ways of saving people, are the ultimate completion.

words.defJa: 内部の仕組みが外から把握しにくい対象

cards.ja: 過去の応募書類と合否の記録を、まず人工知能に学習させる。そうして新しい書類に点数を付けさせ、その結果を新卒採用の書類選考に使う企業が増えている。しかし、深層学習のモデルは膨大な数のパラメータを自動で調整して作られるため、なぜその点数になったのかは、開発した技術者でさえ説明しにくい。中身がブラックボックスのままでは、過去の合否判断に含まれていた偏りをモデルが引き継いでいても、外からは確かめようがない。不採用の通知を受け取った応募者には、書類のどの記述が点数を下げたのかを知る手だてがなく、企業の側もその根拠を示せないまま、翌年の選考が始まる。
cards.en: First, an AI is trained on past application documents and the record of who passed and who failed. More and more companies then have it score new documents and use the results to screen applications in new-graduate hiring. However, because a deep learning model is built by automatically adjusting a vast number of parameters, even the engineers who developed it find it hard to explain why a given score came out. As long as its inner workings remain a black box, there is no way to check from outside whether the model has inherited biases contained in past pass-or-fail decisions. An applicant who receives a rejection notice has no way of knowing which statement in the documents lowered the score, and the next year's screening begins with the company itself still unable to show the basis for it.

words.defJa: 一定の手順で求める答えに到達できる性質

cards.ja: 計算機は年々速くなっている。ならば、いまは手に負えない問題も、いずれは解けるようになると考えたくなる。だが、計算可能性の理論が問うのは、速いか遅いかではなく、答えにたどり着く手順がそもそも存在するかどうかである。チューリングは1936年、どんなプログラムを与えられても、それがいつか止まるかどうかを正しく判定できる万能の手順は存在しないことを示した。どれほど速い機械を何台並べたとしても、動かしたプログラムが止まらないとき、計算がまだ途中なのか、それとも永遠に終わらないのかを一般に見分ける方法はなく、ただ結果を待ち続けるほかない。
cards.en: Computers are getting faster every year. That being so, one is tempted to think that problems beyond our reach today will sooner or later become solvable. But what the theory of computability asks is not whether a machine is fast or slow, but whether a procedure for reaching the answer exists in the first place. In 1936 Turing showed that there is no universal procedure that, whatever program it is given, can correctly decide whether that program will ever halt. However many fast machines are lined up, when a program that has been set running does not stop, there is in general no way to tell whether the calculation is still under way or will never end, and nothing is left but to go on waiting for the result.

words.defJa: モデルの働きを決める調整可能な数値

cards.ja: 学習を始める前のモデルって、どんな質問をしても、でたらめな答えしか返さないんです。中に並んでいる膨大な数の数値がまだランダムなままだからで、答えが外れるたびに、正解とのずれが小さくなるほうへその数値をほんの少しずつ動かしていく、という作業を数えきれないほど繰り返して、やっとまともな答えが出るようになります。こんなにたくさんの数値、人の手で決められっこないですよね。実際、でき上がったモデルのファイルを開いてみても、中身はそうやって調整されたパラメータ、つまり数字の列ばかりなんですよ。
cards.en: A model that hasn't started training yet gives nothing but nonsense answers, whatever question you put to it. That's because the enormous number of values lined up inside it are still random, and every time an answer is off, those values get moved just a tiny bit in the direction that shrinks the gap from the correct answer, and only after this has been repeated more times than anyone could count does the model start giving decent answers. There's simply no way a person could set this many values by hand, after all. In fact, even if you open up the finished model's file, what's inside is the parameters that were adjusted in that way, which is to say nothing but rows of numbers.

words.defJa: 数値などが全体として上向きに増えていくこと

cards.ja: 世界の半導体市場は2023年、メモリー価格の下落が響いて前年を下回った。2019年にも同様の落ち込みがあった。それでも数十年の単位で見れば、市場は右肩上がりの成長を続けてきた。需要が伸びると各社が一斉に増産に動き、数年後には製品が余って価格が崩れるという波を繰り返しながらも、パソコン、スマートフォン、データセンターと、半導体を必要とする製品そのものが増え続けてきたからだ。2024年には人工知能向けの需要が加わり、市場規模は過去最高を更新した。
cards.en: The world semiconductor market fell below the previous year's level in 2023, weighed down by falling memory prices. There was a similar slump in 2019. Even so, viewed on a scale of several decades, the market has kept growing in a sustained upward trend. This is because, even while repeating a cycle in which makers all move to raise output when demand grows and then, a few years later, products pile up and prices collapse, the very range of products that need semiconductors has kept growing, from personal computers to smartphones to data centers. In 2024 demand for artificial intelligence was added on top, and the size of the market set a new record high.

words.defJa: 善い行いや修行によって得られる宗教上の恵み

cards.ja: 四国でお遍路をしていたとき、道ばたで知らないおばあさんにみかんを差し出されたことがあるんです。悪いなと思ったものだから、つい断ろうとしました。そうしたら一緒に歩いていた人が、あれは「お接待」といって、お遍路さんをもてなすのは地元の人にとっても善い行いになるんだから、遠慮しないで受け取るのが礼儀なんですよって、小声で教えてくれたんです。あわててお礼を言って受け取りました。おばあさんのほうが逆に手を合わせて、「こっちこそ功徳を積ませてもらいました」って言うんですよ。
cards.en: Once, when I was walking the pilgrimage in Shikoku, an old woman I didn't know held out a mandarin orange to me by the roadside. I felt bad about taking it, so I started to turn it down without thinking. Then someone who was walking with me quietly told me that this was called osettai, that offering hospitality to pilgrims was a good deed for the local people too, and that the polite thing was to accept without holding back. I hurriedly thanked her and took it. It was the old woman who put her palms together instead and said, "I'm the one who has been allowed to build up merit."

words.meaning: Honen, founder of the Jodo school
words.defJa: 念仏を勧め日本の浄土宗を開いた僧

cards.ja: 法然が人々に求めたのは、ただ「南無阿弥陀仏」と唱えることだけだった。当時の有力な寺院は、経典の学問と厳しい修行を重んじていた。比叡山延暦寺で長く学んだこの僧は、そうした学問や修行ができない人であれ、阿弥陀仏の力を信じて念仏を唱えれば誰もが浄土に生まれることができると説き、その教えは武士や庶民の間にまで広がった。反発した既存の寺院の訴えもあって、1207年、朝廷はその教えを禁じ、本人を四国へ流した。のちに許されて戻り、生涯を閉じた京都・東山の地には、いま浄土宗の総本山である知恩院が建つ。
cards.en: All that Honen asked of people was that they recite "Namu Amida Butsu." The powerful temples of the day set great store by the study of the scriptures and harsh ascetic training. This monk, who had studied for many years at Enryaku-ji on Mount Hiei, taught that even those unable to pursue such learning and training could all be born in the Pure Land if they trusted in the power of Amida Buddha and recited the nembutsu, and his teaching spread as far as the warriors and the common people. Partly because of complaints from the established temples that opposed him, in 1207 the court banned his teaching and exiled him to Shikoku. On the ground in Higashiyama, Kyoto, where he later returned after being pardoned and ended his life, Chion-in, the head temple of the Jodo school, stands today.

words.defJa: 各結果や値にどれほどの確率があるかの分布

cards.ja: チャットボットに同じ質問を何度かしてみたら、答えが毎回少しずつ違った、なんてことありませんか？あれ、気まぐれで変えているんじゃないんです。言語モデルは次に来る語を決めるとき、候補のひとつひとつに「これは六割、こっちは二割」というふうに確率を割り振っておいて、いちばん高いものを必ず選ぶんじゃなく、その確率に応じてくじを引くみたいにして選んでいるんですよ。つまり、モデルが出しているのは決まった答えじゃなくて、次の語についての確率分布なんですね。だから「温度」という設定を下げて、確率の高い候補ばかりが選ばれるようにすると、答えはほとんど毎回同じになります。
cards.en: Have you ever put the same question to a chatbot several times and found that the answer was a little different each time? It isn't changing things on a whim. In deciding on the next word, a language model assigns a probability to each of the candidates, along the lines of "sixty percent for this one, twenty percent for that one," and rather than always choosing the highest, it picks as if drawing lots according to those probabilities. In other words, what the model puts out is not a fixed answer but a probability distribution over the next word. So if you lower the setting called "temperature" so that only the high-probability candidates get chosen, the answer comes out almost the same every time.

words.defJa: 値を大きく変えずに売買を成立させやすい度合い

cards.ja: 同じ金額の株を持っていても、すぐ現金にできるものと、そうはいかないものがあるんですよ。エヌビディアみたいな株は、毎日ものすごい量が売買されています。買いたい人がいつも大勢並んでいるから、少量を売る程度なら、値段は大きく動きにくいんです。困るのは、取引の少ない小さな会社の株みたいに、流動性が低いものなんです。実は前に、そういう株を急いで全部売ろうとしたら、注文を出すそばから値段が下がっていって、売り終わったときには、画面で見ていた評価額より一割近くも少ないお金しか手元に残りませんでした。
cards.en: Even if you hold stocks worth the same amount, there are ones you can turn into cash right away and ones where it doesn't go that smoothly. A stock like Nvidia is bought and sold in enormous volume every day. Because there are always lots of people lined up wanting to buy, the price is unlikely to move much if you are only selling a small amount. The trouble comes with stocks that have low liquidity, like the shares of a small company that are rarely traded. In fact, I once tried to sell all of a stock like that in a hurry, and the price kept dropping as fast as I put my orders in, so that by the time I had finished selling, I was left with nearly ten percent less money in hand than the valuation I had been looking at on the screen.

words.defJa: 珠が互いを映す網で関わり合いを示す華厳の譬え

cards.ja: 雨上がりの朝、庭のクモの巣に細かい水滴がびっしりと並んでいた。顔を近づけると、どの粒にも庭の木と空が小さく映っており、さらに目を凝らせば、隣の粒までがその中に収まっていて、どれが映す側でどれが映される側なのか分からなくなる。華厳の教えが因陀羅網の譬えで説いたのは、遠い天上の話というより、こういう光景なのだろう。帝釈天の宮殿に掛かる網には結び目ごとに珠があり、その珠のそれぞれが他のすべての珠を映しているという。風が吹いて粒がひとつ落ちると、残った粒の中の景色もわずかに揺れた。
cards.en: On a morning after rain, fine drops of water were lined up thickly on a spider's web in the garden. When I brought my face close, every drop held a small reflection of the garden's trees and the sky, and when I looked harder still, even the neighbouring drops sat inside it, until I could no longer tell which was reflecting and which was being reflected. What the Kegon teaching explained through the metaphor of Indra's net was probably not so much a tale of a distant heaven as a sight like this. In the net that hangs in the palace of the god Indra there is a jewel at every knot, and each of those jewels is said to reflect all the other jewels. When the wind blew and one drop fell, the scenery inside the remaining drops trembled slightly too.

words.meaning: early stirrings of a new development
words.defJa: 新しい動きが表面に出る前から起こり始めること

cards.ja: 深層学習の時代はいつ始まったのかと問われれば、多くの人は、この手法を用いた研究チームが画像認識の精度を競う国際大会で二位以下を大きく引き離して優勝した2012年を挙げるだろう。だが、それは花が開いた年にすぎない。画像処理用の半導体で計算を速める試みも、大量の画像を集めて整理する地道な作業も、その数年前から進んでおり、変革の胎動はすでに始まっていた。いま注目を浴びていない研究室では、何が動き始めているのだろうか。
cards.en: Asked when the age of deep learning began, most people would probably name 2012, the year a research team using this method won an international competition in image recognition accuracy by a wide margin over second place and below. But that was merely the year the flower opened. Attempts to speed up computation with chips made for graphics processing and the painstaking work of collecting and organizing huge numbers of images had both been under way for several years before that, and the early stirrings of the transformation had already begun. In the laboratories that draw no attention today, what is beginning to stir?

words.meaning: a state free from distracting attachment
words.defJa: 雑念や執着から離れたとされる心の状態

cards.ja: 初めて座禅会に行ったとき、今日は何も考えないぞって、かなり力んでました。でも、座りっぱなしで足は痛いし、昼ご飯のことは気になるしで、頭の中はかえって騒がしいんです。終わってから、指導してくれたお坊さんに正直にそう話しました。そしたら、にこにこしながら聞いてくれたんです。無の境地に達しようと頑張るのも執着のうちだから、考えが浮かんでも追いかけずに放っておけばいいって言われて、すっと肩の力が抜けたんですよね。
cards.en: The first time I went to a zazen session, I was quite tensed up, telling myself that today I would not think about anything. But my legs hurt from sitting the whole time and I kept worrying about lunch, so the inside of my head was actually noisier than ever. When it was over, I honestly told the priest who had been guiding us just that. And he listened to me with a big smile. He told me that straining to reach a state of nothingness free from distracting attachment is itself a kind of attachment, so when a thought comes up I can just leave it alone without chasing it, and the tension went right out of my shoulders.

words.defJa: 成果や性能を測り比べるための基準となる数値

cards.ja: 「点数は上がったのに、訳が変なんです」って、翻訳モデルを作ってる後輩が相談に来たんです。採点の仕方を聞いたら、原因はすぐ分かりました。人が訳したお手本と単語の並びがどれだけ重なるかだけを数えてたから、意味は合ってるのに言い回しが違うだけの訳まで減点されてたんですよ。それで、意味の近さを測る別の評価指標も並べて見るようにして、最後は人が実際に読み比べた上で判断することにしたら、点数と訳の質が食い違うことが、やっとなくなったそうです。
cards.en: "The score went up, but the translations are strange," said a junior colleague who builds translation models when he came to me for advice. When I asked how the scoring was done, the cause was clear right away. He had been counting nothing but how much the word sequences overlapped with model translations done by people, so even translations that got the meaning right and merely phrased it differently were losing points. So he started looking at another evaluation metric alongside it, one that measures closeness of meaning, and decided to make the final judgment only after people had actually read and compared the translations, and apparently the score and the quality of the translations finally stopped contradicting each other.

words.defJa: 儀礼や師からの伝授を重んじる仏教の教え

cards.ja: 天台宗を開いた最澄は、年下の空海に教えを請うてまで密教を学ぼうとしました。ところが、ある経典の注釈書を貸してほしいという頼みを空海は断り、この教えの最も深い部分は書物を写して身に付くものではなく、師が弟子と向き合って直接授けるものだと手紙で答えたとされます。印の結び方や真言の唱え方に至るまで、弟子は師から一つずつ教わります。真言宗の僧は今も、自分の師からその師へとさかのぼれば空海に行き着く系譜を受け継いでいます。
cards.en: Saichō, who founded the Tendai school, sought to learn esoteric Buddhism even to the point of asking the younger Kūkai to teach him. However, Kūkai is said to have refused his request to borrow a commentary on a certain sutra, answering in a letter that the deepest part of this teaching is not something acquired by copying books but something a master confers directly, face to face with a disciple. Everything down to how to form the mudras and how to chant the mantras is learned by the disciple from the master one item at a time. Even today, Shingon priests inherit a lineage that, traced back from their own master to that master's master, arrives at Kūkai.

cards.enTarget: Saichō, who founded the Tendai school, sought to learn esoteric Buddhism even to the point of asking the younger Kūkai to teach him.

words.defJa: 真言密教で中心となる仏

cards.ja: 太陽は、照らす相手を選ばない。草であれ石であれ、善人であれ悪人であれ、同じように光を注ぐこの天体になぞらえて、インドの密教は、宇宙の真理そのものを一つの仏の姿として思い描いた。歴史上の人物である釈迦と違い、この仏には生まれた年も亡くなった年もない。大日如来と呼ばれるこの仏が曼荼羅の中心に描かれ、周りを多くの仏や菩薩が囲むのは、どの仏もその現れとされるからである。京都の東寺の講堂でも、ずらりと並ぶ仏像の中央に座り、胸の前で静かに印を結んでいる。
cards.en: The sun does not choose whom it shines on. Likening it to this heavenly body, which pours its light equally on grass and stone, on the good and the wicked alike, Indian esoteric Buddhism pictured the truth of the universe itself in the form of a single buddha. Unlike Shakyamuni, who was a historical person, this buddha has neither a year of birth nor a year of death. This buddha, known as Mahāvairocana Buddha, is painted at the center of the mandala with many buddhas and bodhisattvas surrounding him because every buddha is regarded as a manifestation of him. In the lecture hall of Tōji in Kyoto, too, he sits at the center of the long rows of statues, quietly forming a mudra in front of his chest.

cards.enTarget: This buddha, known as Mahāvairocana Buddha, is painted at the center of the mandala with many buddhas and bodhisattvas surrounding him because every buddha is regarded as a manifestation of him.

words.defJa: 個別の用途へ適用する前に広いデータで学ぶこと

cards.ja: 事前学習を終えたばかりの言語モデルは、まだ特定の仕事は何一つ教わっていません。この段階で重ねてきたのは、多くの場合、大量の文書を相手に、次に来る言葉を予測する練習だけです。正解は文書の続きそのものなので、人が答えを用意することなく学習を進められます。予測と正解のずれに応じて、内部の数値がわずかに修正されます。これを膨大な回数繰り返すうちに、言葉の使い方が幅広く身に付くので、その後は比較的少ないデータで調整するだけで、問い合わせへの対応や契約書の要約といった個別の用途に使えるようになります。
cards.en: A language model that has just finished pre-training has not yet been taught a single specific job. In most cases, all it has done at this stage is practice predicting the word that comes next across a vast number of documents. Because the correct answer is simply the continuation of the document itself, the training can proceed without anyone preparing answers. The internal numbers are corrected slightly according to the gap between the prediction and the correct answer. As this is repeated an enormous number of times, the model acquires a broad command of how language is used, so afterward it can be put to individual uses such as answering inquiries or summarizing contracts simply by being adjusted with a comparatively small amount of data.

src.site: 書き下ろし（このデッキ用）

cards.tipJa: 「事前学習を終える・行う」の形で使い、その後の「調整」と対になる機械学習の用語。
cards.enTarget: A language model that has just finished pre-training has not yet been taught a single specific job.

words.defJa: 他と無関係な固定した本質がないこと

cards.ja: すべてのものに固定した本質がないのなら、修行も悟りも、仏の教えさえも成り立たないことになるではないかという批判を、インドの僧、龍樹は主著『中論』の中で自ら取り上げている。彼の答えは、その逆だった。龍樹が空性を説いたのは、何も存在しないと言うためではなく、どんなものも他のものに支えられて初めて成り立つことを示すためであった。だからこそ種は芽を出し、迷う者も悟りに至ることができる。仮に種が固定した本質を持っているとしたら、いつまでたっても種のままだろう。
cards.en: If nothing has a fixed essence, then surely practice, awakening and even the Buddha's teaching itself can no longer hold: this is the criticism that the Indian monk Nāgārjuna himself takes up in his principal work, the Fundamental Verses on the Middle Way. His answer was the opposite. Nāgārjuna taught emptiness not in order to say that nothing exists, but to show that anything at all comes to be only when supported by other things. That is precisely why a seed sprouts and why even a deluded person can arrive at awakening. If a seed did have a fixed essence, it would remain a seed forever.

words.defJa: 仏道を学ぶため各地を巡り歩くこと

cards.ja: 昔の禅僧って、一つの寺でずっと修行するとは限らなかったんですよ。この師匠のもとでは悟れそうにないと思ったら、荷物をまとめて何日も歩いて別の寺を訪ねて、そこでもだめならまた次へ向かうっていうのを、何年も続けるんです。道元もそうでした。宋に渡ってから如浄っていう師匠に出会うまで、二年ほどかかってます。そうやって師匠を探して各地を行脚した末に受け継いだ教えを日本に持ち帰って、のちに永平寺を開くことになるんです。
cards.en: Zen monks in the old days did not necessarily stay and train at one temple the whole time, you know. If a monk felt he was never going to reach awakening under his current teacher, he would pack up his things, walk for days to visit another temple, and if that one was no good either, head for the next, and he would keep that up for years. Dōgen was the same. After he crossed to Song China, it took him about two years to meet the teacher called Rujing. After a pilgrimage like that from place to place in search of a teacher, he brought the teaching he had inherited back to Japan and would later go on to found Eiheiji.

words.defJa: 物事の真実を見極め迷いを離れる仏教の理解

cards.ja: 幼い息子を亡くしたキサーゴータミーが、その子を生き返らせる薬を求めて釈迦を訪ねたところ、釈迦は、まだ死者を出したことのない家からカラシの種をもらってくるようにと告げたといいます。彼女は亡きがらを抱えたまま、村の家々の戸をたたいて回りました。しかし、どの家でも誰かが亡くなっていたと知ったとき、彼女の心に生じたのが、生まれた者は必ず死ぬという真実をありのままに見極める智慧でした。村を出る彼女の手に、カラシの種はありませんでした。
cards.en: When Kisa Gotami, who had lost her young son, went to the Buddha seeking a medicine to bring the child back to life, the Buddha is said to have told her to get mustard seeds from a house that had never yet had a death. Still carrying the body, she went around knocking on the doors of the houses in the village. But when she learned that someone had died in every house, what arose in her mind was the wisdom to see, just as it is, the truth that everyone who is born must die. As she left the village, there were no mustard seeds in her hand.

words.defJa: 一つの変化が周囲へ広がって及ぼす影響

cards.ja: 米バージニア州北部は、データセンターが世界で最も集中する地域として知られる。ここ数年は人工知能の計算需要を見込んだ新設がこの地域をはじめ各地で相次ぎ、画像処理半導体や半導体メモリーはもちろん、サーバーの冷却装置から変圧器に至るまで、関連する製品の注文が急増した。人工知能への投資の波及効果は、こうして半導体産業の外へと広がっている。電力も例外ではない。同州の電力会社は需要の見通しを大幅に引き上げ、発電所や送電線の増設を急いでいる。
cards.en: Northern Virginia in the United States is known as the region where data centers are most concentrated in the world. In the past few years, new facilities built in anticipation of demand for artificial intelligence computing have gone up one after another in this region and elsewhere, and orders for related products have surged, not only for graphics processing chips and memory chips, of course, but for everything from server cooling systems to transformers. In this way, the spillover effects of investment in artificial intelligence are spreading beyond the semiconductor industry. Electric power is no exception. The state's power company has sharply raised its demand forecast and is hurrying to add power plants and transmission lines.

words.reading: ぶんみゃくないがくしゅう
words.defJa: 入力中の例や説明を手掛かりに課題へ対応すること

cards.ja: 言語モデルが文脈内学習を行うとき、重みと呼ばれる内部の数値はまったく更新されません。たとえば、問い合わせの文を「苦情」か「注文」かに分けた例を入力の先頭にいくつか置くと、モデルは注意機構を通じてそれらを参照し、続く新しい文も同じ基準で分類して返します。変わったのは入力だけです。訓練で決まった重みはそのままで、与えられた文脈に応じて出力が変わるにすぎません。入力から例を消せば、モデルは何事もなかったように元の答え方に戻ります。
cards.en: When a language model performs in-context learning, the internal numbers called weights are not updated at all. For example, if you place at the top of the input a few examples in which inquiry messages are sorted into "complaint" or "order", the model refers to them through its attention mechanism and classifies the new message that follows by the same standard. The only thing that has changed is the input. The weights fixed in training stay as they are, and the output merely changes according to the context given. If you delete the examples from the input, the model goes back to its original way of answering as if nothing had happened.

words.defJa: 競争で相手より遅れた位置に立つこと

cards.ja: 米インテルは半導体を自ら設計し、自社の工場で製造してきた。台湾積体電路製造は自社の製品を持つことなく、他社が設計した半導体の製造だけを請け負う。二〇一〇年代後半、回路をさらに細かくする次世代技術への移行でつまずいたのは、インテルのほうだった。量産は計画から何年も遅れた。その間に台湾積体電路製造はアップルやエヌビディアなど多くの顧客から注文を集めて量産の経験を重ね、かつて微細化の先頭に立っていたインテルは、製造技術で同社の後塵を拝する形となった。
cards.en: Intel of the United States has designed its own semiconductors and manufactured them in its own factories. Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company, without having products of its own, takes on only the manufacturing of semiconductors designed by other companies. In the late 2010s, it was Intel that stumbled in the move to next-generation technology that makes circuits still finer. Mass production fell years behind plan. In the meantime, the Taiwanese company gathered orders from many customers such as Apple and Nvidia and built up experience in mass production, and Intel, which had once stood at the forefront of miniaturization, ended up lagging behind it in manufacturing technology.

words.defJa: 半導体への依存が軍事的攻撃を抑止するという比喩

cards.ja: 二〇二五年三月、台湾積体電路製造は米国への投資を千億ドル上積みすると発表した。台湾では不安の声が広がった。世界の最先端半導体の大半を島内で生産していることが中国による武力行使を思いとどまらせるという、いわゆるシリコンの盾が、工場の海外移転によって弱まりかねないと受け止められたためだ。当局は最先端の製造技術を島内に残すと説明したが、世論の疑問は消えなかった。生産拠点が米国に移っても、米国は台湾を守るのか。
cards.en: In March 2025, Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company announced that it would add 100 billion dollars to its investment in the United States. Voices of unease spread in Taiwan. This was because people took it to mean that the so-called silicon shield, the idea that producing most of the world's most advanced semiconductors on the island deters China from using military force, could well be weakened by the relocation of factories overseas. The authorities explained that the most advanced manufacturing technology would be kept on the island, but the doubts in public opinion did not go away. Even if production bases move to the United States, will the United States defend Taiwan?

words.defJa: 有と無の対立を超える根本的な立場

cards.ja: 若いころ禅に打ち込んだ西田幾多郎は、なぜ自らの哲学の根底に絶対無を据えたのか。彼によれば、有るものはすべて何らかの「場所」においてある。物は空間のうちに、その物についての知識は意識のうちにあるというように場所をたどっていくと、最後にはすべてを包む場所に行き着く。だが、それが有るものなら、さらにそれを包む場所が要る。だからその場所は、有と対立する無ですらなく、有と無の対立までも内に包むものでなければならず、色を持たないがゆえにあらゆる色を映す鏡のように、自らは何ものでもないことによって万物を映し出す。
cards.en: Why did Kitaro Nishida, who devoted himself to Zen in his youth, place absolute nothingness at the foundation of his philosophy? According to him, everything that exists exists in some "place". If we trace such places, with a thing lying within space and knowledge of that thing lying within consciousness, we arrive in the end at a place that envelops everything. But if that place is itself something that exists, a further place is needed to envelop it. So that place must not even be the nothingness that stands opposed to being but something that holds within itself the very opposition of being and nothingness, and, like a mirror that reflects every color precisely because it has no color of its own, it reflects all things by being nothing itself.

words.defJa: 究極の実在との直接的な合一や直観を求める立場

cards.ja: ものを知るには二つの道がある。塩について本で学ぶ道と、なめてみる道である。インドの神秘主義が求めてきたのは後者であり、究極の実在は論じる対象というより、自ら直観し、それと一つになるべきものとされた。『チャーンドーギヤ・ウパニシャッド』では、父が息子に塩を水に入れさせ、翌朝、器のあちこちからその水を飲ませる。塩は見えないのにどこを飲んでも塩辛いと答える息子に、父は、目に見えないその微細なものこそが万物の本質なのだと説き、「汝はそれなり」と告げる。
cards.en: There are two paths to knowing a thing. One is to learn about salt from a book, and the other is to taste it. What Indian mysticism has sought is the latter, and ultimate reality was regarded less as an object of discussion than as something to intuit for oneself and become one with. In the Chandogya Upanishad, a father has his son put salt into water and, the next morning, has him drink that water from different parts of the vessel. When the son answers that the salt cannot be seen and yet the water is salty wherever he drinks, the father teaches that this subtle thing, invisible to the eye, is the very essence of all things, and tells him, "You are that."

words.defJa: 在家の仏教徒の基本となる五つの戒め

cards.ja: 去年、インドのブッダガヤで瞑想の合宿に参加したんですけど、最初にやったのは瞑想じゃなかったんですよ。先生の後について、みんなでパーリ語の文句を唱えるんです。意味を聞いて、ちょっと身構えました。生き物を殺さない、盗まない、不適切な性関係を持たない、うそをつかない、お酒を飲まないっていう、在家の信者の基本になる五戒を、合宿の間はきちんと守りますって誓う言葉だったんですよね。お酒以外は普段から守れてる気がしたので、その晩飲むはずだったビールだけあきらめました。
cards.en: Last year I joined a meditation retreat in Bodh Gaya in India, and the first thing we did was not meditation. Following the teacher, we all chant some phrases in Pali. When I asked what they meant, I braced myself a little. They turned out to be words vowing that, for the length of the retreat, we would properly keep the five precepts that are the basis for lay followers: not killing living things, not stealing, not engaging in sexual misconduct, not lying and not drinking alcohol. Apart from the alcohol, I felt I usually manage to keep them, so I just gave up the beer I had been going to drink that night.

words.defJa: 光で微細な回路の模様を材料へ転写する機械

cards.ja: 半導体工場を見学用の窓からのぞくと、ある部屋だけ照明が黄色いことに気づきます。そこで扱うウエハーには光に反応する薬剤が塗られていて、白い照明に含まれる波長の短い光が当たると、回路を写す前に感光してしまう恐れがあるからです。ここで行う作業は、写真の焼き付けに似ています。回路の原版に光を当て、その模様を縮小してウエハーの上に写し取ります。この工程を受け持つ露光装置のうち、最先端の機種を製造できるのはオランダの企業だけで、その輸出には政府の許可が要ります。
cards.en: If you look into a semiconductor factory through the visitors' window, you notice that one room alone is lit in yellow. That is because the wafers handled there are coated with a chemical that reacts to light, and if the short-wavelength light contained in white lighting falls on them, there is a risk that they will be exposed before the circuit is transferred. The work done here resembles making a photographic print. Light is shone on the master pattern of the circuit, and that pattern is reduced in size and transferred onto the wafer. Of the lithography (exposure) tools that handle this step, the most advanced models can be manufactured only by a Dutch company, and exporting them requires government permission.

words.reading: めいそうけいけんしゃ
words.defJa: 瞑想を行った経験を持つ人

cards.ja: 長年にわたって瞑想を続けてきた僧の脳では、注意に関わる領域の活動が一般の人と異なるという報告が相次いだ。だが、これを訓練の成果と決めつけるのはまだ早い。もともと集中力の高い人ほど修行を長く続けやすい、という可能性が残るからだ。差が先にあったのか後から生じたのかは、一度きりの比較では分からない。そこで近年は、瞑想経験者と未経験者を並べて比べるのではなく、未経験の参加者を無作為に二つのグループに分け、一方だけに数週間の訓練を受けてもらって前後の変化を追う研究が目立つようになった。
cards.en: A series of reports found that in the brains of monks who had kept up meditation over many years, activity in regions involved in attention differed from that of ordinary people. But it is still too early to conclude that this is the result of training. That is because the possibility remains that people who had strong concentration to begin with are the ones who find it easier to keep up the practice for a long time. Whether the difference was there first or arose afterward cannot be known from a one-time comparison. So in recent years, rather than setting experienced meditators beside people with no experience and comparing them, studies that randomly divide inexperienced participants into two groups, have only one of them undergo several weeks of training, and follow the changes before and after have become more prominent.

words.defJa: 中国の臨済義玄の系統を引く禅の宗派

cards.ja: 曹洞宗の僧は壁に向かって坐る。坐ることそのものが修行であり、何かを得るための手段ではないとされる。同じ禅でも、栄西が宋から伝えた臨済宗では、修行者は壁を背にして互いに向かい合って坐り、師から公案と呼ばれる問いを与えられる。答えは師の部屋で示すが、知識を並べたにすぎないものは何度でも退けられる。江戸時代に白隠が考え出し、今も入門したばかりの修行者に与えられることの多い公案は、両手を打てば音がする、では片手の音を聞いてこい、というものである。
cards.en: Monks of the Soto school sit facing the wall. Sitting itself is held to be the practice, not a means of gaining something. Even within the same Zen, in the Rinzai school of Zen, which Eisai brought from Song China, practitioners sit with their backs to the wall, facing one another, and are given questions called koans by their teacher. They present their answers in the teacher's room, but ones that merely line up knowledge are rejected again and again. A koan that Hakuin devised in the Edo period, and that is still often given to practitioners who have just entered training, runs like this: clapping both hands makes a sound, so now go and hear the sound of one hand.

words.reading: けいざいあんぜんほしょう
words.defJa: 経済上の手段で国民生活や国家の安全を守ること

cards.ja: かつて半導体は、最も安く作れる場所で作ればよい製品と考えられていた。その前提が崩れた。最先端の製品の生産が台湾など一部の地域に集中した結果、災害や紛争で供給が止まれば、自動車からデータセンターまで幅広い産業が打撃を受けかねないことが明らかになったからだ。日米欧の政府は半導体の確保を、暮らしと産業を守る経済安全保障の柱と位置づけ、巨額の補助金を出して工場の誘致を競っている。熊本では、畑の広がる町に建った台湾の半導体大手の工場がすでに稼働している。
cards.en: Semiconductors were once thought of as products that could simply be made wherever they could be made most cheaply. That assumption has collapsed. This is because production of the most advanced products became concentrated in a few places such as Taiwan, and as a result it became clear that if supply stopped because of a disaster or a conflict, a wide range of industries, from cars to data centers, could be hit hard. The governments of Japan, the United States and Europe have positioned securing semiconductors as a pillar of the economic security that protects daily life and industry, and are competing to attract factories by paying out huge subsidies. In Kumamoto, a factory of a major Taiwanese chipmaker, built in a town of spreading farm fields, is already in operation.

words.defJa: 必要な量に対して余裕がほとんどない状態

cards.ja: 金を払っても、半導体が手に入らない。2023年、対話型の人工知能が急速に広まると、開発各社が性能を競って学習の規模を拡大したため、計算に使う画像処理半導体の注文が特定のメーカーに集中し、製造を請け負う工場の生産能力では追いつかなくなった。需給の逼迫を受けて、納期は大幅に延びた。クラウド事業者が貸し出す計算資源にも、順番待ちの列ができた。資金の乏しい新興企業の中には、必要な計算時間を確保できず、開発の先送りを余儀なくされるところも出た。
cards.en: Even if you pay, you cannot get the chips. In 2023, as conversational artificial intelligence spread rapidly, developers competed on performance and expanded the scale of training, so orders for the graphics chips used in the computation concentrated on a particular maker, and the production capacity of the factories contracted to manufacture them could no longer keep up. As a result of the tightness in supply and demand, delivery times grew much longer. Queues also formed for the computing resources that cloud providers rent out. Among startups short on funds, some could not secure the computing time they needed and were forced to postpone development.

words.defJa: 条件の下で目的に最も合う状態を探すこと

cards.ja: 前の会社で、おすすめ動画の表示順を最適化する仕事をしてたんですよ。目標は単純で、クリックされる回数をいちばん多くすること。数字はすぐ伸びました。でも、それしか見てなかったものだから、上に並ぶのが大げさなタイトルの動画ばっかりになっちゃって。プログラムは言われたとおりにいちばんいい答えを出してただけなので、「最後まで見てもらえたか」も条件に入れて計算し直したら、クリックは少し減ったのに、見てもらえる時間はちゃんと長くなったんです。
cards.en: At my last company, my job was the optimization of the display order of recommended videos. The goal was simple: to get the largest possible number of clicks. The numbers went up right away. But because that was all we were looking at, the videos lined up at the top ended up being nothing but ones with exaggerated titles. The program was only producing the best answer exactly as it had been told to, so when we recalculated with whether people had watched to the end also included as a condition, clicks fell a little, yet the time people spent watching really did get longer.

words.defJa: ある物事を始める最初の例やきっかけ

cards.ja: 日本の電卓メーカー、ビジコンが新しい電卓に使うチップの開発をインテルに依頼したのは、1969年のことだ。両社の技術者による設計を経て、1971年に「4004」が完成した。計算の中心となる回路を一つのチップに収め、プログラムを替えれば電卓以外にも使えるこの製品は、マイクロプロセッサの嚆矢とされ、今日のパソコンやスマートフォンの頭脳へとつながっていく。一度に扱えるデータはわずか4ビットだった。それでもインテルは同じ年、このチップをビジコン以外の企業にも売り出した。
cards.en: It was in 1969 that Busicom, a Japanese calculator maker, asked Intel to develop chips for a new calculator. After design work by engineers from both companies, the 4004 was completed in 1971. This product, which put the circuitry at the heart of computation onto a single chip and could be used for things other than calculators if its program was changed, is regarded as the pioneering first instance of the microprocessor, and it would lead on to the brains of today's personal computers and smartphones. It could handle only 4 bits of data at a time. Even so, in that same year Intel put the chip on sale to companies other than Busicom as well.

words.defJa: あらゆる存在の関わりを説く大乗の経典

cards.ja: 善財童子と呼ばれる少年は、文殊菩薩の勧めに従って南へ旅立ち、僧はもちろん、商人や船乗り、王、子どもに至るまで、五十人を超える師を次々に訪ねて教えを求めます。師の身分や職業は問われません。訪ねた相手はそれぞれ自分の知る範囲のことを語り、次に会うべき人の名を告げて少年を送り出します。旅の終わりに少年が出会うのは、普賢菩薩です。あらゆるものが互いに関わり合うと説く華厳経は、その長い教えを、この少年の旅の物語で締めくくっています。
cards.en: A boy called Sudhana sets out for the south on the advice of the bodhisattva Manjushri and visits more than fifty teachers one after another to ask for their teaching, monks of course, but also merchants, sailors, kings and even children. The rank or occupation of a teacher does not matter. Each person he visits tells him what lies within their own knowledge, gives him the name of the next person he should meet, and sends the boy on his way. The one the boy meets at the end of his journey is the bodhisattva Samantabhadra. The Avatamsaka Sutra, which teaches that all things are bound up with one another, closes its long teaching with the story of this boy's journey.

cards.tipJa: 「華厳経は〜と説く」の形。善財童子の旅の物語を最後の章に置く大乗の経典の名。
cards.enTarget: The Avatamsaka Sutra, which teaches that all things are bound up with one another, closes its long teaching with the story of this boy's journey.

words.defJa: 製造工場を持たず回路の設計などを担う企業

cards.ja: ファブレス企業が新しい半導体を売り出す際、製造の発注が資金計画の節目となる。工場の建設費を自社で負担しない一方で、外部の製造会社へ支払う費用や、製品の販売代金が入るまでの期間を見込み、設計から出荷までの資金を確保するからだ。工場がなくても製造費はかかる。売れる量を多く見積もりすぎれば、完成したチップが在庫として残り、次の開発に使う現金を圧迫する。設計を担う会社の机にも、製造委託の請求書が届く。
cards.en: When a fabless company launches a new semiconductor, placing the manufacturing order becomes a milestone in its financial planning. Although it does not bear factory construction costs itself, it must secure funds from design through shipment while accounting for payments to an outside manufacturer and the delay before sales proceeds arrive. Manufacturing costs remain even without an owned factory. Overestimating sales volume leaves finished chips in inventory and squeezes the cash available for the next development project. An invoice for outsourced manufacturing arrives at the design company too.

words.defJa: 法華経を重んじ題目を唱える実践を説いた鎌倉時代の僧

cards.ja: 題目を唱える声が、法華経への信仰を今に伝える。鎌倉時代の仏教では、さまざまな教えの中で何をよりどころに救いを求めるかが問われ、経典を学ぶ僧侶たちは、修行の方法や人々を導く道をめぐって異なる立場を示した。実践の選択が争点となった。日蓮は法華経を重んじ、南無妙法蓮華経という題目を唱えることを説いた。その教えを受け継ぐ寺院では、僧侶と参拝者が共に声を重ね、経典の名を繰り返し唱えている。
cards.en: The sound of chanting the daimoku carries faith in the Lotus Sutra into the present. In Kamakura-period Buddhism, the question of which teachings to rely on for salvation led monks studying the scriptures to take different positions on methods of practice and paths for guiding people. The choice of practice became a point of dispute. Nichiren emphasized the Lotus Sutra and taught the chanting of the daimoku, Namu Myoho Renge Kyo. In temples continuing his teaching, monks and visitors join their voices in repeatedly chanting the name of the sutra.

cards.tipJa: 法華経を重んじ、題目を唱える実践を説いた僧。時代と土地を混同しない。
cards.enTarget: Nichiren emphasized the Lotus Sutra and taught the chanting of the daimoku, Namu Myoho Renge Kyo.

words.defJa: 本来的には生じも滅びもしないという仏教の表現

cards.ja: 粘土から器が作られ、割れた器が細かな破片になっても、その過程を支える条件から独立した不変の何かが、初めて現れたり完全に消えたりしたとまでは言えない。形は確かに変わっている。般若心経が説く不生不滅も、固定した本質を否定する空の理解に根差す。条件によって成り立つものを、条件抜きで生まれる実体として扱わないのである。机に残った破片にも、もとの土の色と、窯で焼かれた跡がある。
cards.en: Even when clay becomes a vessel and the broken vessel becomes fragments, it does not follow that something unchanging and independent of the conditions supporting that process has newly appeared or vanished completely. The form certainly changes. The Heart Sutra's teaching of neither arising nor ceasing likewise rests on an understanding of emptiness that denies a fixed essence. What depends on conditions is not treated as an entity arising without them. The fragments remaining on the desk still bear the original clay's color and traces of firing in a kiln.

cards.tipJa: 空の理解に関わる語で、日常の形の変化を否定する意味ではない。
cards.enTarget: The Heart Sutra's teaching of neither arising nor ceasing likewise rests on an understanding of emptiness that denies a fixed essence.

words.reading: かぶかしゅうえきりつ
words.defJa: 株価が一株当たり利益の何倍かを示す数値

cards.ja: 同じ会社の株を同じ値段で見ているのに、投資家によって「利益に対して安い」という人と「そうでもない」という人がいるのは、割り算に使う利益が違うからだったりするんだ。昨年度の実績を使う人も、今年度の予想を使う人もいる。割る数が違うんだね。株価を一株当たり利益で割る株価収益率は、どの期間の利益かをそろえてからでないと比べにくいよ。予想を実績にそろえたら、さっきまで違っていた二つの計算結果が重なるんだ。
cards.en: Investors looking at the same company's shares at the same price can disagree about whether they are cheap relative to earnings simply because they use different earnings figures in their division. Some use last year's actual earnings and others this year's forecast. They are dividing by different numbers. The price-to-earnings ratio, calculated by dividing the share price by earnings per share, is hard to compare until the earnings periods are aligned. Once the forecast is replaced with the same actual earnings figure, the two previously different results coincide.

words.defJa: 電気を通す道を部品の間につなぐこと

cards.ja: 「このチップ、計算する場所をもっと詰めれば速くなるんじゃないの」と聞かれたんだ。ところが、信号にも移動時間が要るんだよね。素子を増やすにしても、離れた場所へ何度も信号を送る配線が長くなれば待ち時間が増えるし、線を通す場所や熱を逃がす方法も一緒に考えないと、狙った速さが出ないんだ。計算が終わっても、次の場所に答えが届かなければ待つしかない。その間は、受け取る側の回路が暇になっちゃう。
cards.en: Someone asked me whether packing more computing units onto this chip would make it faster. But signals need time to travel too. Even when adding devices, longer interconnects carrying signals repeatedly to distant locations increase waiting time, and the intended speed will not materialize without also considering space for the wires and ways to remove heat. Even after a calculation finishes, the next location must wait until the answer arrives. During that interval, the receiving circuit ends up idle.

words.defJa: 同業の相手が追いつけないほど優れていること

cards.ja: 半導体向けの設計ソフトで他の追随を許さない地位を築いた企業であっても、顧客が使う製造工程が変われば、新しい条件に合う設計を検証できるよう製品を改良し続けることになる。過去の実績だけでは新工程に対応できない。ソフトの精度が不足すれば、画面上では動く回路が工場では狙いどおりに仕上がらない恐れがある。顧客は設計結果と実際の製品を照合する。次の版へ向けた修正項目は、その差を手掛かりに積み上がっていく。
cards.en: Even a company that has established an unrivaled position in semiconductor design software must keep improving its product to verify designs against new conditions when customers change manufacturing processes. Past achievements alone cannot support a new process. If the software lacks accuracy, a circuit that works on screen may fail to turn out as intended in the factory. Customers compare design results with the actual products. The discrepancies become the basis for an accumulating list of fixes for the next version.

words.defJa: 存在や世界の根本原理を問う哲学の分野

cards.ja: 眠っている間も、昨日の自分と同じ人間であり続ける根拠は何だろう？記憶だけでは答えきれない。仏教の無我説に向き合うと、体や感情や意識が変化するのに、それらを所有する不変の主人を別に立てる必要があるのかという問いが、日常の自明さを揺さぶる。ここで形而上学が問うのは、眠りの深さよりも、そもそも自己がどのように存在するかである。目覚めた人は同じ名で呼ばれながら、また違う気分で朝の支度を始める。
cards.en: What grounds our remaining the same person as yesterday even while asleep? Memory alone cannot fully answer that. Confronting the Buddhist doctrine of nonself unsettles everyday certainties by asking whether changes in body, feelings, and consciousness require a separate, unchanging owner of them all. Metaphysics here concerns how a self exists in the first place, rather than how deeply someone sleeps. On waking, the person is called by the same name yet starts preparing for the morning in a different mood.

words.defJa: 一つの勢力だけが他を大きく上回る状態

cards.ja: 検索サービスの一強を崩そうとする企業には、検索結果の質とは別の壁もある。利用者は毎回サービスを選び直さない。ブラウザーを開いた際に最初から指定されている検索先を使い続けるなら、新規参入の企業は性能を高めても、試してもらう機会そのものを得にくいからである。既定の設定を切り替えられる場所が、競争の入口となる。利用者が別の検索先を選ぶと、次に入力した言葉はそちらの画面へ送られる。
cards.en: A company trying to challenge a single dominant search service faces a barrier separate from the quality of search results. Users do not choose their service afresh each time. If they continue using the search provider preset in their browser, a newcomer can struggle to gain even an opportunity to be tried despite improving its performance. The place where default settings can be changed becomes an entry point for competition. When a user selects another provider, the next search terms entered are sent to that service's screen.

cards.tipJa: 一つの勢力が他を大きく引き離した状態で、「一強を崩す」とも使う。

words.defJa: 機器が単位時間に消費する電気エネルギー

cards.ja: 同じサーバーでも、待機中と大量の計算を実行している最中では電気の使い方が異なり、部品の性能や使用率に応じて、電源に求められる出力も変化する。機器の数が同じでも負荷は一定ではない。稼働の状況を追うには、時刻ごとの測定値を並べる方法が使える。単位時間あたりに使う電気エネルギーを示す消費電力は、その変化を捉える数値となる。処理が集中した時刻には、測定された値の山が記録に残る。
cards.en: Even on the same server, electrical use differs between standby and heavy computation, with the output required from its power supply changing according to component performance and utilization. The load is not constant even when the number of machines stays the same. Measurements arranged by time can track operating conditions. Power consumption, which indicates electrical energy used per unit time, provides a measure of those changes. Periods of concentrated processing leave peaks in the measurement record.

cards.tipJa: 単位時間あたりに使う電気エネルギーの大きさで、稼働状況によって変わる。
cards.enTarget: Power consumption, which indicates electrical energy used per unit time, provides a measure of those changes.

words.term: 営業キャッシュフロー
words.reading: えいぎょうきゃっしゅふろー
words.defJa: 本業の取引によって出入りした現金の差額

cards.ja: 半導体メーカーの営業キャッシュフローを確かめると、製品を出荷して売上を計上した月でも、顧客からの入金が翌月以降なら、その売上に見合う現金がまだ入っていないことが分かります。支払いは待ってくれません。材料代や従業員への給与が先に出ていけば、帳簿に利益があっても手元の現金は減ります。製品を売ることと、代金を受け取ることには時間差が生じ得ます。入金日に通帳へ記された金額が、その隔たりを埋めます。
cards.form: 営業キャッシュフロー
cards.en: Examining a semiconductor manufacturer's cash flow from operating activities reveals that even in a month when products are shipped and sales recognized, the corresponding cash has not yet arrived if customers pay in the following month or later. Payments will not wait. When materials and wages are paid first, cash on hand falls even with a profit on the books. Selling a product and receiving payment can occur at different times. The amount entered in the bank record on the payment date closes that gap.

words.defJa: 自分とは何かを内面に向かって問う実践

cards.ja: 「あなたは誰ですか」と聞かれて職業や家族の中での役割を答えるのは自然だけど、ラマナ・マハルシの教えだと、その答えを知っている「私」そのものへ注意を戻すんだよね。肩書を増やす方向じゃないんだ。名前も思い出も浮かんでは消えるとしても、それを経験しているのは誰なのかと問うんだ。別の考えが出てきたら、それが誰に浮かんだのかをたどる。自己探究を続ける人の注意は、思い出の中の出来事から、それに気付いている自分へと向かうんだ。
cards.en: Answering a question about who you are with your occupation or family role is natural, but Ramana Maharshi's teaching turns attention back toward the very “I” that knows those answers. It does not proceed by adding titles. Even as names and memories arise and disappear, the question is who experiences them. When another thought appears, one traces whom it has occurred to. Someone continuing self-inquiry directs attention from events in memory toward the self aware of them.

ruby: だけど、ラマナ・マハルシの
cards.tipJa: ラマナの教えでは、経験している「私」の根源へ注意を向ける実践。
cards.enTarget: Someone continuing self-inquiry directs attention from events in memory toward the self aware of them.

words.defJa: 自分自身の生として引き受けられる具体的な存在

cards.ja: 会社での役目を離れた人が禅寺の坐禅会に参加し、肩書も職歴も問われずに静かに座るとき、他人から与えられた評価を離れて、自分はこれから何をよりどころに生きるのかという問いが起こることがある。代わりに座ってもらうことはできない。そこで向き合う実存の問題は、人間一般の性質を知ることより、他人に代われない生を自分で引き受けることにある。坐禅が終わって門を出た足は、来た道と同じ道を、今度は帰るために歩き始める。
cards.en: When someone who has left a workplace role attends a Zen sitting session and sits quietly without being asked for a title or career history, the question may arise of what to live by beyond evaluations bestowed by others. No one can sit in their place. The question of personal existence encountered there concerns taking responsibility for a life no one else can live, more than knowing the characteristics of humanity in general. When sitting ends and the person leaves through the gate, their feet begin along the same road as before, now on the journey home.

words.defJa: 使うために必要とされる電気の量

cards.ja: 計算処理の実行時刻にも調整の余地がある。データセンターでは、利用者への即時応答が必要な処理を続ける一方、期限までに終わればよい大量の計算を、設備の稼働状況に応じて別の時間帯へ移す運用が考えられる。これにより、電力需要が特定の時間に集中するのを抑えられる場合がある。総使用量が減るかどうかとは別の効果だ。夜間へ回された処理は順番に実行され、翌朝の利用に向けて結果が保存される。
cards.en: The scheduling of computation leaves room for adjustment. A data center can continue tasks requiring immediate responses while shifting large calculations that only need to meet a deadline to other periods according to equipment utilization. This can sometimes reduce the concentration of electricity demand in particular hours. That effect is separate from whether total consumption falls. Tasks shifted to nighttime run in sequence, and their results are saved for use the following morning.

words.defJa: 伸びが止まって、それ以上上がらない状態

cards.ja: 解答を見れば分かる問題でも、白紙から解こうとすると途中で手が止まります。分かった感覚と再現は別です。成績が頭打ちになった段階では、教材を増やす前に、どこまで自力で進めるかを確かめる方法が役立ちます。例えば数学なら、解答を伏せたまま途中の式を再現し、根拠を言えなかった箇所に印を付け、その部分だけを確認してから、別の問題で同じ考え方を使えるか試します。次のノートには、答えより先に計算の道筋が並びます。
cards.en: Even with a problem that makes sense when the solution is visible, you can get stuck when starting from a blank page. Feeling that you understand differs from reproducing the solution. When scores plateau, checking how far you can get independently before adding more materials can help. In mathematics, for example, reconstruct the intermediate steps with the solution hidden, mark any step you cannot justify, review that part, and then test whether the same reasoning works on another problem. The next notebook page presents the path of calculation before the answer.

src.site: 書き下ろし（このデッキ用）

cards.tipJa: 成績などの伸びが止まった状態で、「頭打ちになる」と使う。
cards.enTarget: When scores plateau, checking how far you can get independently before adding more materials can help.

words.defJa: 現在のものに続いて登場する新しい世代

cards.ja: 次世代の通信規格へ移るにあたっては、携帯端末の中の半導体を新しくするだけで済まず、その規格で信号を送受信する基地局側の対応や、使う地域の通信環境も普及の条件となる。端末だけが先に進んでもつながらない。利用者の手元では、対応する場所へ移動して初めて新しい方式が使える場合もある。旧来の方式を使い続けられる機能は、移行の途中を支える。街を離れた端末が、利用できる別の方式へ通信を切り替える。
cards.en: Moving to the next generation of communications standards requires more than replacing semiconductors inside mobile devices, because base stations must also support transmitting and receiving the signals and local network conditions affect adoption. Devices moving ahead alone cannot establish a connection. A user may only be able to use the new mode after moving into a supported area. Retaining the ability to use older modes supports the transition. As a device leaves the city, it switches communications to another available mode.

src.site: 書き下ろし（このデッキ用）

cards.tipJa: 現在のものに続く新しい世代で、「次世代の通信規格」のように使う。
cards.enTarget: Moving to the next generation of communications standards requires more than replacing semiconductors inside mobile devices, because base stations must also support transmitting and receiving the signals and local network conditions affect adoption.

words.defJa: 日本や中国でかつてインドを指した呼び名

cards.ja: 日本の古い仏教説話にインドの王や僧が登場すると、身近な寺で受け継がれてきた教えの舞台が海の向こうへ広がり、人々が釈迦が教えを説いた土地を遠い聖地として思い描いたことが伝わります。信仰は、行ったことのない土地とも人を結びます。中国や朝鮮半島を経て届いた経典とともに、その地の名も日本へ伝わり、物語の中に残りました。天竺を目指す旅人は、道中の困難を越えながら、インドにあると伝え聞いた仏の教えの源へ近づいていきます。
cards.en: When Indian kings or monks appear in old Japanese Buddhist tales, the setting of teachings passed down at familiar temples expands overseas, conveying how people imagined the land where the Buddha taught as a distant sacred land. Faith connects people with places they have never visited. Along with scriptures reaching Japan through China or the Korean Peninsula, the name of that land traveled and remained in stories. Travelers bound for Tenjiku overcome difficulties along the road as they approach the source of the Buddha's teaching that they have heard lies in India.

cards.tipJa: かつてインドを指した名で、仏教説話や求法の旅の舞台として現れる。
cards.enTarget: Travelers bound for Tenjiku overcome difficulties along the road as they approach the source of the Buddha's teaching that they have heard lies in India.

words.defJa: 一定の割合で繰り返し増えたり減ったりする様子

cards.ja: 数字だけの暗証番号は、桁を増やすと候補が急増する。短い番号なら、試せる候補も少ない。各桁で同じ数の数字から選べるとすれば、桁が増えるたびに候補の総数にその数を掛けることになり、増え方は前の候補数を基礎としてさらに大きくなる。計算機が順に照合する仕事も膨らむ。候補を試す速さが変わらない限り、桁数に対して指数関数的に増える組合せが、照合を終えるまでの待ち時間を引き延ばしていく。
cards.en: For a numeric passcode, adding digits rapidly increases the number of candidates. A short code has fewer candidates to try. If each position offers the same number of digits, every added position multiplies the total by that number, making the increase itself grow from the previous total. The work of sequential checking by a computer also expands. As long as the checking rate stays constant, combinations that increase exponentially with the number of digits stretch the wait until checking is finished.

cards.tipJa: 同じ倍率で増え、前の増加分も次の増加の土台となる様子。
cards.enTarget: As long as the checking rate stays constant, combinations that increase exponentially with the number of digits stretch the wait until checking is finished.

words.defJa: 禅の修行を導く師への敬称

cards.ja: 禅の修行を始めた友人が、師に会う前からやけに緊張してるんだ。年上の人と話すからというだけでもなさそうだよ。老師と呼んで敬っているその師には、自分では順調だと思っていた修行のことも率直に尋ねられるので、友人はうまく答えようと考えるあまり、昨夜はあれこれ頭を悩ませたらしいんだ。ようやく会えた日は、用意していた立派な答えを途中でやめて、今いちばん困っていることをそのまま話したって言ってたよ。
cards.en: A friend who has begun Zen training is already terribly nervous before meeting his teacher. It seems to be more than simply talking to someone older. His venerable Zen teacher, whom he addresses respectfully as roshi, asks directly even about practice he thought was going well, and apparently my friend worried over all sorts of things last night in his eagerness to answer well. He said that when they finally met, he abandoned his polished answer halfway through and simply talked about what was troubling him most.

cards.enTarget: His venerable Zen teacher, whom he addresses respectfully as roshi, asks directly even about practice he thought was going well, and apparently my friend worried over all sorts of things last night in his eagerness to answer well.

words.defJa: 回路や部品を載せる土台となる板

cards.ja: 基板が割れた電子機器って、部品が無事ならそのまま使えると思う？その板には、部品同士をつなぐ細い配線も通ってるんだよ。途中で切れたら、電気は届かないよね。見た目の割れが小さくても、内部の配線まで傷んでいると、外から眺めただけじゃ場所を特定できない。修理する人が切れた所を探してつなぎ直すと、同じ部品のままでも信号が通るようになって、消えていた画面がまた点灯することもあるんだ。
cards.en: Do you think an electronic device with a cracked circuit board will still work as it is if its components are intact? That board also carries fine wiring connecting its components. If a connection breaks, electricity cannot get through. Even a small visible crack can involve damaged internal wiring whose location cannot be identified just by looking from outside. When a repairer finds and reconnects a break, signals may pass again with the same components, and a screen that had gone dark can light up once more.

cards.tipJa: 部品を載せる板で、回路の配線を支える役割もある。
cards.enTarget: Do you think an electronic device with a cracked circuit board will still work as it is if its components are intact?

words.defJa: 禅などの仏教思想を海外にも紹介した思想家

cards.ja: 禅を海外へ伝えた仕事は、著作の題名にも刻まれている。英語で禅の経験や日本文化との関わりを論じる活動を続けるかたわら、浄土真宗にも関心を寄せ、日本の仏教を異なる角度から海外へ届ける作業が進められた。鈴木大拙の仕事である。その関心は、単独の宗派の紹介に収まらなかった。日本語で『日本的霊性』を著したこの思想家は、晩年にも親鸞の思想と向き合い、『教行信証』の英訳を完成させた。
cards.en: The work of bringing Zen overseas is reflected even in the titles of his books. Alongside sustained activity discussing Zen experience and its relationship to Japanese culture in English, an interest in Shin Buddhism led to work presenting Japanese Buddhism overseas from another angle. This was the work of Daisetz Suzuki. His interests exceeded the introduction of a single denomination. The thinker who wrote Japanese Spirituality in Japanese continued engaging with Shinran's thought late in life and completed an English translation of Kyogyoshinsho.

cards.tipJa: 禅の海外紹介に加え、浄土真宗にも関心を寄せた近代の仏教思想家。
cards.enTarget: This was the work of Daisetz Suzuki.

words.defJa: 何もなく、ただ広がりだけがある空間のこと

cards.ja: 仏教では慈悲の広がりが虚空に譬えられます。壁で区切られた部屋と違い、何ものにも遮られず果てしなく広がる空間を思い浮かべると、親しい相手にしか向かわない思いやりとの隔たりが際立ちます。好き嫌いで範囲を決めない慈悲です。相手から礼を返してもらえないとしても、苦しむ人への願いをそこで打ち切りません。心の中に引いていた境界を外せば、今まで遠ざけていた相手も、安らかであってほしいと願う人の輪に入ってきます。
cards.en: In Buddhism, the reach of compassion is compared to boundless space. Imagining space that extends endlessly without obstruction, unlike a walled room, brings out its distance from kindness directed only toward people close to us. This is compassion whose reach is not set by likes and dislikes. Even without receiving thanks, one does not end one's wishes for a suffering person there. Removing a boundary drawn in the mind brings someone previously kept at a distance into the circle of people one wishes to be at peace.

words.defJa: 発明や創作などから生まれる無形の財産

cards.ja: 半導体の会社なのに、売り物が完成したチップじゃなくて設計だって聞くと、少し意外だよね。製造する工場は、取引先が用意するんだ。こうした商売では、独自の回路設計などの知的財産が収入を支えているよ。物を運ばなくても、使う許可が取引になるんだね。契約に応じて設計の使える範囲や支払い方を決めた後、買った会社はその設計を自分たちの製品に組み込み、売った会社には利用料が入る、という流れになるんだ。
cards.en: It seems a little surprising to hear that a semiconductor company sells designs rather than finished chips. The customer provides the manufacturing facility. Intellectual property such as original circuit designs supports revenue in this kind of business. Permission to use something can be traded without shipping an object. After the permitted scope of use and payment terms are set by contract, the purchasing company incorporates the design into its products and the selling company receives licensing fees.

words.defJa: 寺院に信仰上の所属などを証明させた制度

cards.ja: 江戸期の宗門人別帳には、人々の名や年齢とともに所属する寺も記された。単なる参拝者の名簿ではない。寺請制度の下で、寺院は檀家がキリシタンではないことを証明する役割を担った。人々の宗教上の所属が、村や町の住民を把握する仕組みと結び付いていたのである。本人がどれほど熱心に祈っていたかにかかわらず、行政の記録では人は家ごとの構成員として並べられ、それぞれの暮らしに寺との制度上のつながりが付いて回った。
cards.en: Edo-period religious population registers recorded people's affiliated temples along with names and ages. They were not merely lists of temple visitors. Under the temple certification system, temples certified that their parishioners were not Christians. Religious affiliation thus became linked with systems for identifying village and town residents. Regardless of how fervently individuals prayed, administrative records listed them as members of households, and institutional ties to a temple accompanied their lives.

words.defJa: 心身に厳しい負担を課す宗教的な修行

cards.ja: 苦行に耐えた日々は、修行者にとって誇りにもなり得る。つらかった記憶ほど手放しにくい。仏教が自らを痛めることへの偏りを退けるとき、問われるのは努力をしたかどうかより、その努力を自分の価値の証拠として抱え込み、新たな執着にしていないかという点でもある。痛みは消えても、他人と比べる心が残る。寒さをしのぐ衣を前にしても、かつて薄着で耐えた自分を誇り続けるなら、その人は今、何から自由になろうとしているのだろうか？
cards.en: Days of enduring austerities can become a source of pride for a practitioner. Painful memories can be especially hard to release. When Buddhism rejects an inclination toward self-torment, it also asks whether effort is being held as proof of personal worth and made into a new attachment, rather than merely whether effort was made. Pain may disappear while the impulse to compare oneself with others remains. If someone facing a garment that would ward off the cold still takes pride in having endured with thin clothing, what is that person now trying to become free of?

words.defJa: 仏教で戒を受け仏弟子となる際に授けられる名

cards.ja: おばあちゃんが元気なうちに、お寺で仏弟子としての名前を授かることにしたんだって。家族は最初、もうお葬式の準備を始めるのかと驚いたそうだよ。住職から戒を受けて仏の教えに沿って生きようと決めた人が授かる名前だから、亡くなった後に限るものじゃないと聞いて、みんな安心したらしいんだ。新しい戒名を受け取ったおばあちゃんは、これから毎日お参りするときに、その名前を見て自分の誓いを思い出したいって話してるよ。
cards.en: Apparently my grandmother has decided to receive a name as a disciple of the Buddha at her temple while she is still healthy. At first the family was surprised, thinking she was already beginning funeral preparations. Everyone apparently felt reassured on hearing that the name is for someone who receives precepts from the priest and resolves to live by the Buddha's teaching, so it is not restricted to after death. Having received her new Buddhist precept name, she says she wants to look at it during her daily prayers from now on and remember her vow.

words.defJa: 将来を悪い方向へ進むと見る考え

cards.ja: 人工知能の会社は赤字から抜け出せないっていう悲観論を聞いたんだ。モデルの開発費が重いうえに、利用者が増えるたびに計算の費用もかかるから、売上げが伸びても利益につながりにくいという見立てなんだよね。それはまだ予測だよ。計算の効率や料金が変われば収支も動くし、今の赤字だけから先の結果を決めるのは早いと思う。友人はその話を聞いた後、次の決算では売上げと費用がそれぞれどう変わったかを確かめると言っていたよ。
cards.en: I heard a pessimistic outlook claiming that artificial intelligence companies cannot escape losses. The view is that heavy model-development expenses and computing costs that rise with additional users make revenue growth difficult to turn into profit. That is still a prediction. Changing computational efficiency or prices would also change the balance, and I think it is too early to decide the future from current losses alone. After hearing this, a friend said he would check how revenue and costs had each changed in the next earnings announcement.

words.meaning: all plants and lands attain buddhahood
words.defJa: 草木や大地まで仏となるとする教え

cards.ja: 草木国土悉皆成仏という教えを前にすると、寺の石段さえ、人が仏を拝むための足場という役割には収まりきらなくなる。踏まれる側にも目が向く。草木や大地まで仏となるという宗教的な広がりは、人の心だけを切り離して救いを求める姿勢とは異なり、生きる場所そのものを問いの中へ招き入れる。草履についた土を払い、雨でぬれた石段を上るとき、仏となる世界の外を通り過ぎているのではなく、その世界に足を置いているのだとすれば、礼拝は本堂の扉より手前から始まっている。
cards.en: Faced with the teaching that all plants and lands attain buddhahood, even temple steps exceed the role of a footing from which people worship a Buddha. Attention turns toward what is trodden on. A religious vision in which even plants and earth become Buddhas draws the place of living itself into the question, unlike an approach that seeks salvation by isolating the human mind. If brushing soil from one’s sandals and climbing rain-wet steps means placing one's feet within the world becoming Buddha rather than passing outside it, worship has begun before the main hall's doors.

words.defJa: 禅の修行に励む僧や諸方を巡る修行僧

cards.ja: 禅寺の修行には、僧が町へ出て鉢を持ち、人々から施しを受ける托鉢も含まれ、生活を支える食べ物や金銭が寺の外から届けられる。修行の場は山門の内側に限らない。雲水と呼ばれる修行僧も、こうした実践を通じて地域の人と接する。差し出された物を受け取る側と、教えを支えようとする側が、路上で向き合う。僧の手元にある鉢には、人々が自分の暮らしから分けた物が入り、僧はそれを受けて次の家の前へと進んでいく。
cards.en: Zen monastic training includes going into town with bowls to receive alms, through which food and money supporting life come from outside the temple. Practice is not confined within its gates. Trainee monks called unsui also meet local people through such practice. Those receiving offerings and those wishing to support the teaching face one another in the street. People place things shared from their own lives into the bowl in a monk's hands, and he receives them and proceeds to the next house.

cards.tipJa: 禅の修行僧を指し、托鉢などを通じて寺の外でも実践を行う。
cards.enTarget: Trainee monks called unsui also meet local people through such practice.

words.defJa: 複数の計算機で共通の決定を成立させること

cards.ja: 分散合意を用いるシステムでは、離れたサーバーが設定変更を共通の決定として扱う。例えば多数のサーバーの確認を取ってから決定する方式では、変更案を送った機械だけが新しい値を勝手に確定することを避け、通信の遅れや故障に備えつつ記録をそろえる。全員の返事を待つ必要はない。通信が途切れ、規則で定めた応答を集められない側では新たな変更の確定を保留し、別々の設定を同時に正しいものとして進める事態を防ぐ。
cards.en: In systems using distributed consensus, separate servers treat a configuration change as a common decision. For example, a method that decides after confirmation from a majority avoids allowing the proposing machine alone to finalize a new value, aligning records while accounting for communication delays and failures. It need not wait for everyone's reply. A side that loses communication and cannot gather the responses required by the rules holds off finalizing new changes, preventing different settings from simultaneously being treated as authoritative.

cards.tipJa: 複数の計算機が、共通の決定を成立させる仕組み。
cards.enTarget: In systems using distributed consensus, separate servers treat a configuration change as a common decision.

words.defJa: インドの古い聖典群。師の膝元の教えを意味する語

cards.ja: 世界中の財産が自分のものになれば、死を超えられるでしょうか？家を離れる前に財産を分けようとする夫へ、妻のマイトレーイーはこの問いを向け、豊かに暮らせても財産によって不死にはなれないという答えを聞きます。ウパニシャッドに含まれるこの対話は、何を持つかという話から、自己の本質を知る探究へ進みます。望むものが富では得られないと分かった妻は、財産の話を続けるかわりに、夫の知る教えを自分にも伝えてほしいと求めます。
cards.en: Could we transcend death if all the world's wealth became ours? Maitreyi poses this question to her husband as he prepares to divide his property before leaving home, and hears that wealth can provide a prosperous life but cannot confer immortality. This dialogue in the Upanishads proceeds from what one possesses to inquiry into the nature of the self. Realizing that wealth cannot give her what she seeks, the wife asks her husband to share his teaching rather than continuing the discussion of property.

src.site: 書き下ろし（このデッキ用）

ruby: のマイトレーイーはこの
cards.tipJa: 自己や世界の根本を探究する古代インドの文献群で、対話の形でも教えを伝える。
cards.sense: 師のそばで伝える密かな教え、およびそれを記す文献
cards.enTarget: This dialogue in the Upanishads proceeds from what one possesses to inquiry into the nature of the self.

words.defJa: 新しい技術や製品を作る速さや性能を争うこと

cards.ja: 人工知能向けの半導体を設計する企業が、新製品で処理速度を高めても、電力消費が大幅に増えるなら、冷却や電源の費用を負担する顧客は採用をためらう。速さだけでは決まらない。競合企業は同じ仕事をより少ない電力で処理する設計を示し、運用費の低さを訴える。開発競争の焦点は、計算の速さから電力効率にも広がる。購入側の比較表には装置の価格とともに使用時の費用が並び、設計側も消費電力を減らすために回路の構成を見直す。
cards.en: Even if a company designing chips for artificial intelligence raises processing speed in a new product, sharply higher power consumption can make customers paying for cooling and power supplies hesitate to adopt it. Speed alone does not decide the matter. A competitor presents a design performing the same task with less electricity and stresses lower operating costs. The focus of the development race expands from computing speed to power efficiency. Buyers' comparison tables list operating costs alongside equipment prices, and designers also revise circuit structures to reduce electricity consumption.

cards.tipJa: 新しい技術や製品の性能を競い合い、開発の焦点が変わる場面で用いる。
cards.enTarget: The focus of the development race expands from computing speed to power efficiency.

words.defJa: 日本に戒律を伝え唐招提寺を開いた唐の僧

cards.ja: 鑑真が開いた唐招提寺は、戒律を学ぶ人々の修行の場として始まった。当初から今の伽藍がそろっていたのではない。はじめは講堂や、以前の建物を改造した経蔵などがあるだけだった。現在残る金堂は弟子の如宝の尽力によって完成したとされ、師が築いた学びの場を受け継ぐ人々が、修行を続けるとともに寺の姿も整えていった。寺の境内には、教えを授けた師の仕事と、それを残すために動いた弟子たちの仕事が、建物の歴史として重なっている。
cards.en: Toshodaiji, founded by Ganjin, began as a training place for people studying monastic discipline. Its present buildings were not all in place from the beginning. Initially there were only a lecture hall and facilities such as a scripture repository made by adapting an earlier building. The surviving main hall is said to have been completed through the efforts of his disciple Nyoho, as those inheriting the teacher's place of learning continued practice and developed the temple's physical form. Within its grounds, the work of the teacher who transmitted the teaching and the disciples who acted to preserve it overlap in the history of the buildings.

cards.enTarget: Toshodaiji, founded by Ganjin, began as a training place for people studying monastic discipline.

words.defJa: 言葉を直接交わして教えなどを伝えること

cards.ja: お供えを終えた後、若い僧が師に儀礼の意味を尋ねたとするよ。順番は覚えていても、なぜその動作をするのかまでは分からなかったので、自分が迷った所を話し、師からその場に合った答えを直接受け取るんだ。こうした口伝は、教えを声で受け渡す営みなんだね。弟子の問いに応じて、伝える内容も深まっていく。次に同じ儀礼をする日、その僧は前と同じ手順を踏みながらも、師と交わした言葉を思い出して、供物にそっと手を添えるんだ。
cards.en: Suppose a young monk asks his teacher about the meaning of a ritual after making an offering. Although he remembers the sequence, he does not yet understand why the movements are performed, so he describes what puzzled him and directly receives an answer suited to that situation. Oral transmission like this passes teachings from one voice to another. What is conveyed grows deeper in response to the disciple's questions. On the next occasion that he performs the same ritual, the monk follows the same steps but recalls the words exchanged with his teacher and gently places a hand on the offering.
