cards.enTarget: Standing on the banks of the Ganges as it flows across the land of India, the meaning of the word "eternity" soaks into your body.

words.defJa: 人の性格を形づくる傾向

cards.ja: 自己紹介で「明るい性格です」と言うだけでは、相手の記憶には残りません。心理学者たちが整理した性格特性は、外向性や誠実性といった傾向の強さを表すものにすぎず、白か黒かの区別ではないからです。話すときは、その傾向が表れた具体的な出来事を一つ添えると、印象が立体的になります。たとえば「初対面でも、まず自分から質問します」のように、行動の形で語るのがコツです。面接の場でも、同じ手法が使えます。
cards.en: Merely saying "I have a cheerful personality" in a self-introduction will not stay in the listener's memory. The personality traits that psychologists have organized are nothing more than the strength of tendencies such as extraversion and conscientiousness, not a black-or-white distinction. When you speak, adding one concrete episode in which the tendency showed itself makes the impression three-dimensional. The trick is to speak in terms of behavior, for example, "even with someone I've just met, I ask the first question." The same method works in an interview, too.

cards.tipJa: 心理学の用語。「外向性」など性格を測る側面。「性格」より専門的。
cards.enTarget: The personality traits that psychologists have organized are nothing more than the strength of tendencies such as extraversion and conscientiousness, not a black-or-white distinction.

words.reading: せいちょうまいんどせっと
words.defJa: 能力は努力で伸びると信じる態度

cards.ja: スタンフォード大学の心理学者キャロル・ドゥエックは、人の能力は努力で伸ばせると信じる態度を「成長マインドセット」と名づけました。反対に、才能は生まれつき決まっていると考える態度が「固定マインドセット」です。前者の子どもは、失敗を能力の証明ではなく学びの材料として受け止めるため、難しい課題にも挑戦しやすいと報告されています。ただし、褒め言葉を変えるだけで身につくものではなく、教える側の振り返りも欠かせません。
cards.en: The Stanford psychologist Carol Dweck named the attitude of believing that one's abilities can be developed through effort the "growth mindset." In contrast, the attitude of thinking that talent is fixed from birth is the "fixed mindset." Children with the former take failure not as proof of ability but as material for learning, and so are reported to take on difficult tasks more readily. However, it is not acquired just by changing how you praise, and reflection on the teacher's side is also indispensable.

words.defJa: 天皇に代わって政務を執る役

cards.ja: 天皇が幼少または病気などで政務を執れないとき、代わって政治を行う役職を摂政という。古くは聖徳太子が推古天皇のもとでこの役を務めたと伝えられ、のちに藤原氏は、天皇の外戚の立場を利用して政権を掌握し、摂関政治を築いた。しかし院政や武家政権の台頭により、実権は次第に失われていく。現代でも皇室典範に規定があり、実際に置かれたのは、大正期に皇太子だった昭和天皇が務めたのが最後である。
cards.en: The post that takes over the conduct of government in place of the emperor when he cannot handle political affairs because he is a child or ill is called sesshō, or regent. In ancient times Prince Shōtoku is said to have filled this role under Empress Suiko, and later the Fujiwara clan, using their position as maternal relatives of the emperor, took control of the government and built the regency-based politics of sesshō and kanpaku. But with the rise of cloistered rule and warrior governments, real power was gradually lost. Even today the Imperial House Law contains provisions for it, and the last time one was actually installed was when Emperor Shōwa, then crown prince, served in the Taishō period.

words.defJa: 根拠を確かめながら考える姿勢

cards.ja: 批判的思考とは、他人を批判することではなく、与えられた情報を鵜呑みにせず、根拠と結論のつながりを自分で確かめる姿勢です。たとえば「この食品は健康にいい」と言われたら、誰が、どんな調査で、何と比べて言っているのかを問います。この習慣がつくと、後知恵バイアスや思い込みにも気づきやすくなり、判断の質が上がります。もっとも、疑ってばかりでは何も決められないので、確かめる範囲に線を引くことも必要です。
cards.en: Critical thinking is not criticizing others; it is an attitude of not swallowing given information whole and checking for yourself the link between evidence and conclusion. If someone says "this food is good for your health," for example, you ask who is saying it, based on what kind of study, and compared with what. Once you form this habit, you notice hindsight bias and preconceptions more easily, and the quality of your judgment rises. That said, you can't decide anything if you only doubt, so it is also necessary to draw a line around the range you check.

cards.enTarget: Critical thinking is not criticizing others; it is an attitude of not swallowing given information whole and checking for yourself the link between evidence and conclusion.

words.defJa: 自分の感情を他人のものと見なす心の働き

cards.ja: 心理学でいう投影とは、自分の中にある認めたくない感情を、他人のものであるかのように見なしてしまう働きを指す。たとえば、自分が相手を嫌っているのに、「あの人は私を嫌っている」と思い込むような場合である。この仕組みは、自分を守るために無意識に働くため、本人にはなかなか気づけない。カウンセリングでは、そうした思い込みを丁寧にほぐし、感情の持ち主を取り戻す作業が行われる。
cards.en: Projection in psychology refers to the workings by which one regards feelings within oneself that one does not want to admit as if they belonged to someone else. For example, it is a case like being convinced that "that person dislikes me" when it is actually you who dislike them. Because this mechanism works unconsciously in order to protect oneself, it is hard for the person to notice. In counseling, the work is done of carefully loosening such convictions and recovering the true owner of the feeling.

words.defJa: 活動の足場となる場所

cards.ja: 半導体メーカーが海外に工場を建てるとき、まず検討されるのは、人材、電力、水、そして地政学的な安定性です。台湾に偏っていた先端半導体の生産拠点を分散させようという動きは、供給の途絶を避けたい各国の思惑とも重なっています。工場を一つ新設するだけで、関連企業や研究機関が周りに集まり、地域全体が変わることもあります。ただし、熟練工の不足から、予定どおりに稼働できないという課題も浮かび上がっています。
cards.en: When a semiconductor maker builds a plant overseas, what is considered first is talent, electricity, water, and geopolitical stability. The moves to spread out the production bases for advanced semiconductors, which had been concentrated in Taiwan, also overlap with the calculations of countries that want to avoid supply disruption. Just by building one new plant, related companies and research institutions gather around it and the whole region can change. However, a shortage of skilled workers is also coming to light as a problem, preventing operation as planned.

words.defJa: 深く追究する

cards.ja: 優れたエッセイは、一つの小さな出来事を、読者が思いもよらない深さまで掘り下げる。たとえば、朝の電車で席を譲られたという些細な体験から、善意とは何か、老いとは何かへと問いが広がっていく。そこでは、結論を急がず、最初の感想を疑い、なぜそう感じたのかを何度でも問い直す姿勢が要る。浅い共感で終わらせないために、書き手には探究心が欠かせないのである。その問いに自分の言葉で答えようとする過程こそが、文章に深みを与える。
cards.en: A fine essay digs one small incident to a depth the reader never imagined. From the trivial experience of being offered a seat on the morning train, for instance, questions spread to what goodwill is and what old age is. There, what is needed is an attitude of not hurrying to a conclusion, doubting the first impression, and asking over and over why one felt that way. In order not to end with shallow empathy, the writer cannot do without a spirit of inquiry. The very process of trying to answer that question in your own words gives the writing depth.

words.defJa: 声の高低や強弱の変化

cards.ja: 同じ「ありがとうございます」でも、抑揚のつけ方ひとつで、心からの感謝にも、形ばかりの挨拶にも聞こえます。話すときは、伝えたい言葉の直前で、ほんの一拍だけ間を置いてみてください。そのうえで、その言葉を少し高く、ゆっくり発音すると、聞き手の耳が自然とそこに集まります。逆に、すべてを一定の調子で読み上げると、どれほど内容が良くても、眠気を誘うだけになってしまいます。話し手に心の余裕がないと、声は自然と平板になりがちです。
cards.en: Even the same "arigatō gozaimasu" can sound like heartfelt gratitude or a perfunctory greeting depending on how you set the intonation. When you speak, try pausing for just a beat right before the word you want to convey. Then, if you pronounce that word a little higher and more slowly, the listener's ear naturally gathers there. Conversely, reading everything out in a constant tone only puts people to sleep, however good the content is. If the speaker has no composure to spare, the voice tends to go flat on its own.

words.defJa: 気分が沈み意欲が出ない状態

cards.ja: 抑うつとは、気分が沈み、何をしても楽しめない状態が続くことを指します。誰にでも、悲しいことがあれば一時的に落ち込む時期はありますが、二週間以上ほとんど毎日続くようなら、医療機関への相談が勧められます。大切なのは、「気の持ちようだ」「怠け癖だ」と本人や周囲が片づけてしまわないことです。心的外傷や過労など、背景にある要因を一緒にほどいていく姿勢が、回復への第一歩になります。
cards.en: Depressed mood refers to a state in which your mood sinks and you cannot enjoy anything you do. Everyone goes through periods of temporary low spirits when sad things happen, but if it lasts almost every day for two weeks or more, consulting a medical institution is recommended. What matters is that the person and those around them do not dismiss it as "it's all in the mind" or "just laziness." An attitude of untangling the underlying factors together, such as psychological trauma or overwork, becomes the first step toward recovery.

words.defJa: 弱い立場の者から不当に利益を取ること

cards.ja: 大航海時代の後、ヨーロッパの列強は、各地に拠点を築き、アジアやアフリカ、アメリカ大陸で、現地の人々を労働力として使い、富を本国へ吸い上げた。砂糖やコーヒー、綿花のプランテーションは、そのための装置であった。搾取という言葉は、こうした制度が、単なる経済活動ではなく、暴力と法制度によって支えられていたことを思い出させる。今日の私たちの豊かな暮らしも、この歴史と無縁ではない。
cards.en: After the Age of Discovery, the European powers established bases in various places and, in Asia, Africa, and the Americas, used local people as labor and drew wealth back to the home country. Plantations of sugar, coffee, and cotton were the apparatus for that. The word "exploitation" reminds us that such systems were not mere economic activity but were supported by violence and legal institutions. Our own affluent lives today are not unrelated to this history either.

words.defJa: 行動の方向を示す基準

cards.ja: AIを社会に出すとき、何を守り、何を禁じるのか。その指針を、ここ数年で各国が競うように作っています。欧州連合は法律という強い形で縛るのに対し、日本はまず事業者の自主的な取り組みを尊重する、という方向を取ってきました。どちらが正解かは、運用の結果を見てみなければ、今のところ誰にも分かりません。ただ、技術の推移に合わせて見直し続けられる仕組みを持つことが、どの国にも共通する課題です。
cards.en: When putting AI out into society, what should be protected and what should be forbidden? Countries have been drawing up guidelines for this as if competing over the past few years. The European Union binds through the strong form of law, whereas Japan has taken the direction of first respecting the voluntary efforts of businesses. No one can say for now which is the right answer until the results of actual operation are seen. But having a mechanism that can keep being revised as technology progresses is a challenge common to every country.

words.defJa: 語尾の音をそろえること

cards.ja: ラップってさ、押韻がすごいじゃん。「ライム」って呼ばれる、語尾の母音をそろえる技なんだけど、日本語は母音が五つしかないから、韻を踏みやすい反面、単調になりやすいとも言われるんだよね。それなのに、昔は「日本語はラップに向かない」なんて言われてて、不思議だよね。たぶん、拍の数が決まった俳句や短歌の感覚が、リズムの捉え方を縛ってたんだと思う。ただ、最近は日本語の自然な語順を生かした新しい韻の踏み方も増えている。
cards.en: Rap is amazing for its rhyme, you know? It's a technique called "rhyme," lining up the vowels at the ends of words, and since Japanese has only five vowels, it's said to be easy to rhyme but also prone to monotony. Even so, people used to say "Japanese doesn't suit rap," which is strange. I think maybe the sense of haiku and tanka, with their fixed number of beats, was binding the way we grasp rhythm. Recently, though, new ways of rhyming that take advantage of Japanese's natural word order have also been increasing.

words.defJa: 仏になること

cards.ja: 日本ではいつしか、「成仏」という言葉が「亡くなって安らかに眠る」という意味で使われるようになった。だが本来の仏教では、仏になること、つまり悟りを開くことを指し、生きているうちにこそ目指すべきものとされる。浄土宗や浄土真宗では、阿弥陀仏の力によって往生し、仏になると説く。宗派によって捉え方が大きく異なるため、葬儀の場で戒律や作法を尋ねる遺族も少なくない。ただ、どの宗派でも、死者の安らぎを願う気持ちは共通している。
cards.en: In Japan, the word "jōbutsu" has come at some point to be used to mean "passing away and resting in peace." In original Buddhism, however, it refers to becoming a buddha, that is, attaining enlightenment, and is something to be aimed at while one is still alive. In the Pure Land schools, it is taught that through the power of Amida Buddha one is reborn in the Pure Land and becomes a buddha. Because understanding differs greatly by school, quite a few bereaved families ask about precepts and etiquette at funerals. Still, in every school the wish for the repose of the dead is shared.

words.defJa: 語の後ろにつく要素

cards.ja: 「〜的」「〜化」「〜性」は、名詞の後ろにつけて新しい語をつくる接尾辞の代表である。「抽象」に「化」をつけて「抽象化」、「安全」に「性」をつけて「安全性」と、造語の力が非常に高い。日本語の専門用語の多くは、こうした要素の組み合わせでできており、仕組みを知っていれば未知の語でも意味を推測できる。とはいえ、「〜的」を安易に重ねると、かえって意味がぼやける点には注意が必要だ。
cards.en: "-teki," "-ka," and "-sei" are representative suffixes that attach after a noun to make a new word. Adding "-ka" to "chūshō" gives "chūshōka," and adding "-sei" to "anzen" gives "anzensei," so their word-forming power is very high. Many Japanese technical terms are made from combinations of such elements, and if you know the mechanism you can guess the meaning even of an unknown word. That said, one should be careful that stacking "-teki" carelessly instead blurs the meaning.

words.defJa: あげる・くれる・もらうの類

cards.ja: 「先生が私に本をくださった」「私は友達に宿題を見せてもらった」のように、物や行為のやりとりを表す授受表現は、日本語学習者がもっとも苦労する文法のひとつです。ポイントは、誰の視点で話しているかを考えることにあります。「あげる」「くれる」「もらう」は、英語では与えるという一語で足りる場面でも、話し手に近い側へ向かうかどうかで使い分けられます。この視点の感覚が身につかないまま、敬語が絡む場面ともなると、混乱は一気に増します。
cards.en: Giving-and-receiving expressions, which express the exchange of things and actions, as in "the teacher gave me a book" and "I had my friend show me the homework," are among the grammar points that learners of Japanese struggle with most. The key is to think about whose viewpoint you are speaking from. "Ageru," "kureru," and "morau" are used differently depending on whether the action heads toward the side closer to the speaker, even in situations where English manages with the single word "give." If this sense of viewpoint is not acquired, then in situations involving honorifics, confusion increases all at once.

words.defJa: 過去を見直して学ぶこと

cards.ja: 企業の研修で、プロジェクト終了後の振り返りを制度化する動きが広がっている。成果を確認するだけでなく、うまくいかなかった理由を、個人の責任にせず仕組みの問題として話し合うのが狙いだ。このとき心理的安全性が確保されていないと、参加者は当たり障りのない発言に終始し、本質的な反省は表に出ない。形だけの会議に陥らないために、司会役の力量が問われている。会議の後で匿名のアンケートを取る方法も、有効な補助手段だという。
cards.en: In corporate training, moves to institutionalize a retrospective after a project ends are spreading. The aim is not only to confirm results but to discuss the reasons things didn't go well as problems of the system rather than individual responsibility. If psychological safety is not secured at this point, participants confine themselves to inoffensive remarks and real reflection does not come to the surface. To avoid falling into a meeting in form only, the capability of the facilitator is being tested. Collecting an anonymous questionnaire after the meeting is also said to be an effective supplementary measure.

words.defJa: 拠点や事業から退くこと

cards.ja: 半導体メーカーが特定の地域から撤退を決めたとき、その影響は工場の閉鎖にとどまらない。取引先の部材メーカーや物流会社、地元の雇用にまで連鎖するため、自治体は誘致の段階で、手を引くときの条件を取り決めておくべきだという声が強まっている。企業側も、一度築いた拠点を手放すには、巨額の設備投資の回収という重い問題を抱える。進出や閉鎖の判断は、需要の推移だけでなく、地政学的な懸念にも左右されるようになった。
cards.en: When a semiconductor maker decides to pull out of a particular region, the impact is not limited to the closing of the plant. Because it chains through to parts suppliers, logistics firms, and local employment, voices are growing that local governments should settle the conditions for pulling out already at the stage of attracting the company. The companies too face the heavy problem of recovering enormous capital investment in order to give up a base once built. Decisions on entering or closing have come to be swayed not only by the course of demand but also by geopolitical concerns.

cards.en: What is often asked in reading comprehension problems is what the demonstratives such as "sore," "kono," and "ano" refer to. The basic approach is to look in the sentence just before, but it is not necessarily the one just before. Actually substituting the phrase you found into the place of the demonstrative and reading it to confirm that the meaning holds is the reliable procedure. If it doesn't hold, don't decide on a preconception; go back one more sentence and search again. Note also that "sore" can sometimes point ahead to what comes next, so look carefully at the flow before and after.

cards.en: When you mark down a baby's height and weight on the maternal and child health handbook at checkups, you can see them rising smoothly along the band of the growth curve. What matters is not whether the numbers are above or below the average but whether the child has strayed far from his or her own curve. Learning is the same: to feel impatient by comparing with others' progress is to forget that the shape of the curve differs from person to person. Periods that look like stagnation make you feel you have failed, but they are often a preparation for the next growth.

words.meaning: to trip someone up on words

cards.en: In a debate, you seize on the other person's slip of the tongue or small quibbles and attack them on something unrelated to the main issue. This is called "ageashi o toru." An example is a scene in which, to someone who said "everyone is in favor," you retort, "No, one person was absent so it isn't everyone." Such remarks look rigorous at first glance but in fact only lower the level of abstraction of the discussion and divert attention from the essential content. If you want constructive dialogue, it is important to grasp the other's intention and dig into the substance first.

words.meaning: bearer, the one who carries (a role)

cards.en: Open-source AI development is advancing not through a handful of giant companies but with developers around the world as its bearers. Someone reports a bug, someone else proposes a fix, and yet another documents how to use it. Such distributed cooperation can make faster improvement possible than a closed organization. On the other hand, in recent years there is also the concern that, because many contributors work unpaid, the maintenance of important software leans on a few volunteers.

I think it'd be better to set clear guidelines for its use first and, if anything, make it a tool for training critical thinking. Honestly, I don't think this is something a ban alone can settle.

words.defJa: 「ん」の音

cards.ja: 「ん」は、日本語の五十音図の最後に置かれているが、単語の頭には決して立たない。この撥音は、一拍の長さを持つ特殊な音の一つで、後ろの音によって発音が変わる点も特徴的である。「さんぽ」では唇を閉じた「ム」に近く、「さんか」では喉の奥で響く音になるが、日本語話者はそれを同じ一つの音と感じている。こうした違いに意識が向かないのは、母語の音の体系が、聞き分けの枠をあらかじめ作ってしまうからだ。
cards.en: The "n" sits at the end of the Japanese gojūon chart, but it never stands at the head of a word. This moraic nasal is one of the special sounds having the length of one beat, and it is also characteristic that its pronunciation changes depending on the sound that follows. In "sanpo" it is close to an "m" with the lips closed, and in "sanka" it becomes a sound resonating at the back of the throat, yet Japanese speakers feel them to be one and the same sound. That our attention does not go to such differences is because the sound system of the mother tongue forms the frame of discrimination in advance.

words.defJa: 個別から共通の本質を取り出すこと

cards.ja: 優秀な人は、個別の経験から本質だけを取り出して、別の場面にも使える形に変える、という抽象化が得意です。たとえば、料理が上手な人は、一つのレシピを覚えるのではなく、火加減と味付けの原理を理解していて、材料が変わっても対応できます。ビジネス書を読んでも成果が出ない人は、事例をそのまま真似しようとして、背後にある原理を取り出せていません。つまり、学びの質を決めるのは、量ではなく、どれだけ抽象度を上げて持ち帰れるかなのです。
cards.en: Capable people are good at abstraction: pulling only the essence out of individual experiences and turning it into a form usable in other situations. A person skilled at cooking, for instance, doesn't memorize a single recipe but understands the principles of heat and seasoning, and so can cope even when the ingredients change. People who read business books and get no results try to imitate the cases as they are and cannot extract the principles behind them. In short, what determines the quality of learning is not the quantity but how much you can raise the level of abstraction before taking it home.

In fact, in phases where prices rise on expectations alone, unsupported by corporate performance, even slight bad news can easily trigger a sharp fall. Speculation and investment are distinguished by time horizon and by where the grounds are placed, but in practice the boundary is often blurred. Experts advise individual investors to write down trading guidelines in advance so as not to be swept along by the psychology of loss aversion.

cards.en: Prefixes in Sino-Japanese words such as "fu," "mi," "hi," and "mu" attach before a word and add a negative meaning. Yet just as we say "fukanzen" but not "mukanzen," and "miseinen" exists but "fuseinen" does not, which one can be chosen is determined word by word. For that reason, learners have no choice but to memorize combinations one by one like idiomatic expressions. Still, knowing the mechanism gives you a clue for guessing the meaning of a word you see for the first time.

words.defJa: 相手に攻撃を思いとどまらせる力

cards.en: The theory of deterrence rests on the paradoxical idea that nuclear weapons protect peace by not being used. During the Cold War, the United States and the Soviet Union, by each holding the ability to destroy the other for certain, created a situation in which even the one who attacked first would not escape unharmed. The balance that arose in this way was a precarious tightrope walk, but it is also credited with having prevented direct war between the great powers. If either side were to misread the other's intentions, deterrence would collapse in an instant. That tension was the essence of the Cold War.

words.defJa: 日本語のリズムの単位

cards.ja: 俳句の五七五は、音節ではなくモーラを数える詩型である。「ん」「っ」「ー」のような音も一つ分の長さをもつので、「ラーメン」は四つと数える。このモーラは、音楽でいえば一拍にあたる単位であり、日本語のリズムが強弱ではなく長さによって刻まれることを教えてくれる。英語が強勢で調子をとる言語であるのと、対照的だ。俳句の字数がふつう十七音と呼ばれるのも、この数え方を反映したものである。
cards.en: The 5-7-5 of haiku is a verse form that counts moras rather than syllables. Sounds such as "n," "tsu," and the long vowel mark also have one unit of length, so "rāmen" is counted as four. This mora corresponds, in musical terms, to a single beat, and it tells us that the rhythm of Japanese is carved by length rather than by stress. This contrasts with English, a language that keeps its rhythm by stress. That the length of a haiku is usually called seventeen sounds also reflects this way of counting.

words.defJa: 抽象的であるかどうかの程度

cards.ja: 教育現場で、「もっと具体的に書きなさい」と指導されて困った経験がある人は多いだろう。実は、文章の抽象度は上げ下げが自在にできてこそ、読み手に伝わる。「自然を大切にしよう」という標語は、あまりに漠然としていて行動に結びつかず、「ごみを持ち帰ろう」まで下げて初めて、実行可能な指針になる。反対に、細部ばかりを並べる文章は、全体の主張が見えにくい。要するに、伝えたい相手に合わせた高さに調整できるかが鍵となる。
cards.en: Many people have probably been at a loss at school after being told "write more concretely." In fact, a text gets through to its reader only when the level of abstraction can be freely raised and lowered. A slogan like "let's cherish nature" is too vague to connect to action and becomes an actionable guideline only once it is lowered to "let's take our trash home." Conversely, writing that merely lines up details makes the overall claim hard to see. In short, the key is whether you can adjust it to a height suited to the person you want to reach.

words.defJa: 決まった意味をもつ言い回し

cards.en: Hearing "abura o uru," nobody pictures a person actually selling oil. An idiom is a fixed phrase whose overall meaning cannot be obtained by adding up the meanings of the individual words. It is said that because oil sellers in the Edo period would chat at length with customers while doing business, it came to mean idling at work and gossiping. In learning a foreign language, memorizing set phrases like these whole is far more practical than taking them apart word by word.

Restating the same content in different words like this is an effective means of organizing an argument and is also often useful at the stage of polishing. In academic papers, this expression is often used alongside "sunawachi." However, if what you meant as a rephrasing brings in a new point, it confuses the reader, so caution is needed.

cards.ja: 日本語を学ぶ外国人にとって、拗音は最初の関門のひとつです。「きゃ」「しゅ」「ちょ」のように、小さい「ゃ・ゅ・ょ」が前の音とくっついて一拍になるため、「しよ」と「しょ」は別の音として聞き分けなければなりません。聴解に限らず発音の試験でも、「びょういん」と「びよういん」の差を問う問題がよく出ます。まず口の形を意識して、長さの微差を耳で捉える練習から始めましょう。
cards.en: For foreigners learning Japanese, contracted sounds are one of the first hurdles. As with "kya," "shu," and "cho," the small "ya, yu, yo" fuses with the preceding sound to make a single beat, so you have to hear "shiyo" and "sho" as different sounds. Not only in listening but in pronunciation tests, questions asking the difference between "byōin" and "biyōin" come up often. Start by being conscious of the shape of your mouth and practicing catching the slight difference in length by ear.

words.defJa: 体で覚えた動作や手順の記憶

cards.ja: 自転車に乗れるようになった人は、たとえ十年乗っていなくても、またがればすぐにペダルをこげます。このように、体で覚えた動作や手順についての記憶を手続き記憶といいます。言葉で説明するのは難しいのに、体は自然に動く。忘却曲線で描かれる記憶とは違い、長い空白があっても薄れにくいのが特徴です。一方、「フランスの首都はパリ」のような知識は意味記憶と呼ばれ、別の脳の仕組みで支えられています。
cards.en: A person who has learned to ride a bicycle can pedal right away once they get on, even if they haven't ridden in ten years. This kind of memory of movements and procedures learned by the body is called procedural memory. It is hard to explain in words, yet the body moves naturally. Unlike the memories depicted by the forgetting curve, it is characteristically hard to fade even after a long gap. By contrast, knowledge such as "the capital of France is Paris" is called semantic memory and is supported by a different brain mechanism.

words.defJa: 自分たちの、の意の連体語

cards.ja: 我が国に仏教が伝わったのは、六世紀半ばのこととされています。百済の王から仏像と経典が贈られたという記録が、『日本書紀』に残っています。その後、聖徳太子が仏教の保護に力を注ぎ、律令国家の精神的な支柱として育てられていきました。仏教の受容に伴って、寺院や僧侶を支える制度も整えられていったのです。なお、日本に入った経典の多くは、サンスクリット語から中国語に訳されたものを通じて、もたらされたものです。
cards.en: Buddhism is said to have reached our country in the mid-sixth century. A record that the king of Baekje presented a Buddha image and scriptures remains in the Nihon Shoki. After that, Prince Shōtoku devoted effort to protecting Buddhism, and it was nurtured as a spiritual pillar of the ritsuryō state. With the acceptance of Buddhism, the systems supporting temples and monks were also put in place. Incidentally, most of the scriptures that entered Japan were brought through versions translated from Sanskrit into Chinese.

words.defJa: 修行者が守るべき規則

cards.ja: ミャンマーやタイの僧院では、今も二百を超える戒律を守って暮らす比丘が少なくない。金銭を手にしないこと、正午を過ぎて食事をとらないことなど、日常のごく細かな点まで定められている。こうした規則は、行動を縛るためというより、心を乱す原因を日々の暮らしから遠ざけるためにあるという。在家の信者にとっても、五戒を意識することは、日々の振り返りの手がかりになっている。その細かさは、宗派や地域ごとに少しずつ異なる。
cards.en: In monasteries in Myanmar and Thailand, quite a few monks still live keeping more than two hundred precepts. Even the finest points of daily life are laid down, such as not handling money and not eating after noon. These rules are said to exist less to bind behavior than to keep the causes of mental disturbance away from daily life. For lay believers too, being mindful of the five precepts serves as a clue for daily reflection. How detailed they are differs a little by school and region.

words.defJa: 同音で二つの意味を重ねる和歌の技法

cards.ja: 小倉百人一首の「花の色はうつりにけりないたづらに我が身世にふるながめせしまに」は、掛詞の技法をよく示す歌として知られる。「ふる」は「世に経る」と「雨が降る」、「ながめ」は「物思いにふける」と「長雨」の二つの意味を重ねている。換言すれば、一つの音に二つの情景を担わせることで、花の盛りが過ぎた嘆きと、降り続く雨の風景が溶け合うのである。この技法は、日本語に同音異義語が多いことと深く結びついている。
cards.en: The poem in the Ogura Hyakunin Isshu, "Hana no iro wa utsuri ni keri na itazura ni wa ga mi yo ni furu nagame seshi ma ni," is known as a song that shows the technique of pivot words well. "Furu" overlaps "to pass through the world" and "rain falls," and "nagame" overlaps "to brood in thought" and "long rain." In other words, by making one sound carry two scenes, the lament that the flower's prime has passed and the landscape of unending rain melt together. This technique is deeply tied to the fact that Japanese has many homophones.

words.defJa: 時間とともに移り変わること

cards.ja: 明治から昭和初期にかけて、日本の人口は約三千五百万人から七千万人余りへと増えた。この推移を支えたのは、農業生産の向上と衛生状態の改善による死亡率の低下である。しかし、増えた人口を養う土地は限られていたため、農村の過剰な人口は、都市の工場の担い手になる一方、海外への移民へも向かった。統計の数字の裏にある、人々の暮らしの変化を読み解くことが、近代史の理解には欠かせない。
cards.en: From the Meiji era to the early Shōwa period, Japan's population grew from about thirty-five million to a little over seventy million. What supported this shift was the fall in the death rate from improved agricultural production and sanitation. But because land to feed the larger population was limited, the surplus population of farming villages became bearers of the labor of urban factories while also heading overseas as emigrants. Reading the changes in people's lives behind the statistical figures is indispensable to understanding modern history.

words.reading: しょうにんよっきゅう
words.defJa: 他人に認められたい欲求

cards.ja: SNSの「いいね」の数が気になって仕方がない。それは意志が弱いからではなく、承認欲求という人間の根本的な欲求が刺激されているからです。心理学者マズローは、これを欲求の階層の上のほうに位置づけました。ただ、他人の評価だけに頼って自分の価値を測っていると、数字が減ったとたんに不安になり、心の余裕を失ってしまいます。大事なのは、他人からの承認と、自分で自分を認める感覚とを、両方バランスよく育てることです。
cards.en: You can't help worrying about the number of likes on social media. That's not because you're weak-willed but because a basic human need called the need for approval is being stimulated. The psychologist Maslow placed this in the upper part of his hierarchy of needs. But if you rely only on others' evaluations to measure your worth, you become anxious the moment the number drops and lose your peace of mind. What matters is to cultivate in balance both approval from others and the feeling of acknowledging yourself.

words.defJa: 力が釣り合って譲らないこと

cards.ja: 歴史の場面を語るとき、勝敗の結果だけを述べると、ドラマが生まれません。たとえば、関ヶ原の戦いなら、両軍の兵力が拮抗していたこと、どちらにも勝機があったことを先に示します。そうすれば、聞き手は「どうなるのか」と身を乗り出し、小早川秀秋の寝返りという転換点が、いっそう鮮やかに響きます。結末を知る側に生じる後知恵バイアスを自覚し、緊張の置き方に気を配るのが、語り手の腕です。
cards.en: When you tell a scene from history, stating only the outcome of victory and defeat produces no drama. For the Battle of Sekigahara, for example, you first show that the forces of the two armies were evenly matched and that either side had a chance to win. Then the listener leans forward wondering how it will turn out, and the turning point of Kobayakawa Hideaki's defection rings out all the more vividly. Being aware of the hindsight bias that arises in those who know the ending and paying attention to how tension is placed is the storyteller's skill.

cards.enTarget: For the Battle of Sekigahara, for example, you first show that the forces of the two armies were evenly matched and that either side had a chance to win.

words.defJa: 習慣として定着した決まった表現

cards.ja: 外国人向けの日本語教育では、「手を焼く」「口が堅い」といった慣用表現が長く難所とされてきた。字面から意味を推測できないため、学習者の多くが中級以降でつまずくからだ。近年の教材は、一つ一つを場面とセットで示し、似た意味の表現との微差も説明するようになっている。換言すれば、定義を暗記させる教育から、使える状況を体験させる教育への転換が進んでいるのである。こうした表現は、文化的な背景と結びついているものが多い。
cards.en: In Japanese-language education for foreigners, idiomatic expressions such as "te o yaku" and "kuchi ga katai" have long been regarded as a stumbling block. Because the meaning cannot be guessed from the written form, many learners trip up from the intermediate level onward. Recent teaching materials present each one together with its setting and also explain the slight differences from expressions of similar meaning. In other words, education is shifting from having learners memorize definitions to having them experience the situations in which an expression can be used. Many of these expressions are tied to cultural background.

words.defJa: 損を得より強く嫌う心理

cards.ja: 人は、一万円を得る喜びよりも、一万円を失う痛みのほうを、およそ二倍も強く感じるといわれる。行動経済学でいう損失回避である。そのため、含み損を抱えた株をなかなか売れず、さらに傷を広げるという失敗が絶えない。これは意志の弱さというより、人間の脳が持つ癖であり、後知恵バイアスのように、頭で分かっていても働いてしまう。だからこそ、事前に売却の条件を決めておく指針が、感情を手放す助けになる。
cards.en: People are said to feel the pain of losing ten thousand yen about twice as strongly as the joy of gaining ten thousand yen. This is what behavioral economics calls loss aversion. For that reason, failures keep occurring in which people cannot sell a stock carrying an unrealized loss and widen the wound. This is less weakness of will than a quirk of the human brain, and like hindsight bias it operates even when one understands it in the head. That is exactly why a guideline that fixes the conditions of sale beforehand helps in letting go of emotion.

words.defJa: 文章を練り直して磨くこと

cards.ja: メール一本書くにも、送る前に必ず声に出して読むようにしてるんだよね。推敲って、目で追うだけだと気づけないことが多くて、耳で聞くと「ここ、つっかえるな」って分かるんだよ。同じ言葉が続いてたり、指示語が何を指してるか分からなかったり、意外といろいろ出てくる。ちょっと面倒だけど、これをやるだけで、揚げ足を取られるようなメールがぐっと減った気がする。やっぱり文章は、声に出して読むに限るよ。
cards.en: Even when writing a single email, I make a point of always reading it aloud before sending. With polishing, there's a lot you can't notice just by following with your eyes, but when you listen with your ears you can tell, "this spot trips me up." Repeated words, demonstratives where you can't tell what they point to, all sorts of things come up, surprisingly. It's a bit of a bother, but just doing this seems to have sharply cut the emails people could pick holes in. Reading aloud really is the best way to polish.

words.defJa: 辛抱強く耐える

cards.ja: うちのばあちゃん、ほんとに我慢強いんだよね。膝が痛くても「大丈夫」って言って、病院に連れて行くまで絶対に弱音を吐かないの。でも、あれって美徳なのかなってたまに思う。感情の起伏までしまい込んでると、本人も周りも気づかないうちに、心身が悲鳴を上げかねないでしょ。この前なんて、熱があるのに夕飯を作って待っててくれて、ありがたいやら申し訳ないやらで、胸が痛くなったんだよね。
cards.en: My grandma is really patient and enduring. Even when her knee hurts she says "I'm fine," and she absolutely won't complain until we take her to the hospital. But I sometimes wonder if that's really a virtue. If she keeps even the ups and downs of her feelings bottled up, her mind and body might cry out before she or anyone around her notices, you know? The other day, even with a fever, she made dinner and waited for me, and I felt a pang, both grateful and sorry, you know?

words.defJa: 戦争のあとの賠償や領土などの処理

cards.ja: 第二次世界大戦の終結から数年のあいだ、連合国は敗戦国との戦後処理をめぐって、立場を一致させることができなかった。賠償の規模、領土の線引き、占領の期間といった課題が、両陣営の対立を深め、その後の国際秩序の推移を左右したのである。日本の場合は、一九五一年にサンフランシスコ平和条約が結ばれ、翌年に主権を回復した。だが、その枠組みに加わらなかった国との関係整理は、のちの世代にまで持ち越された。
cards.en: For several years after the end of World War II, the Allied powers could not agree on a position regarding the postwar settlement with the defeated countries. Issues such as the scale of reparations, the drawing of territorial lines, and the length of occupation deepened the confrontation between the two camps and shaped the course of the subsequent international order. In Japan's case, the San Francisco Peace Treaty was concluded in 1951, and sovereignty was restored the following year. But the settling of relations with countries that did not join that framework was carried over to later generations.

cards.enTarget: For several years after the end of World War II, the Allied powers could not agree on a position regarding the postwar settlement with the defeated countries.

words.defJa: うまくいった経験

cards.ja: 成功体験は、人を育てる最良の栄養であると同時に、最も危険な毒にもなる。一度うまくいったやり方は、環境が変わったあとも手放しにくく、気づけば思考停止のまま同じ手順を繰り返すことになる。かつて新技術の波に押し流された名だたる大企業が対応を誤ったのも、過去の栄光を疑えなかったからにほかならない。本当の強さとは、勝ち方を知っていることではなく、勝ち方を捨てる勇気を持つことであろう。
cards.en: Experiences of success are the best nourishment for growing a person and, at the same time, can become the most dangerous poison. A method that worked once is hard to let go of even after the environment changes, and before you know it you are repeating the same procedure in a state of thoughtless inertia. Famous large corporations that were swept away by waves of new technology misjudged their response precisely because they could not doubt their past glory. True strength lies not in knowing how to win but in having the courage to throw away the way you won.

words.defJa: 計画や気力がくじけること

cards.ja: 挫折を経験したことのない人間は、おそらく何も挑戦してこなかった人間であろう。ただし、同じつまずきでも、人によって受け止め方は大きく異なる。ある人はそれを能力の限界の証と見なして立ち止まり、別の人は成長曲線の途中に現れる谷として歩み続ける。その差を生むのは才能ではなく、失敗に与える意味づけであり、そこには成功体験の積み重ねとは別の訓練が要る。失敗を恐れず、その後に何をするかが、人の器を決めるのだろう。
cards.en: A person who has never experienced a setback is probably one who has never attempted anything. However, even for the same stumble, how people take it differs greatly. One person regards it as proof of the limit of their ability and stops, while another keeps walking, seeing it as a valley that appears along the way of a growth curve. What produces that difference is not talent but the meaning one gives to failure, and that requires a training separate from the accumulation of successful experiences. What a person does afterward, without fear of failing, probably determines their capacity.

words.defJa: 決議などを阻止できる権利

cards.ja: 国連安全保障理事会では、常任理事国の五か国のうち一国でも反対すれば、重要な決議は採択されない。この拒否権は、一九四五年の国連創設時に、大国の協力なしには国際秩序は維持できないという現実に基づいて設けられた。しかし冷戦期以降、自国や同盟国の利害を守るために行使される場面が目立ち、機能不全が批判されている。改革案は何度も議論されてきたが、既得権を持つ側が手放そうとしないため、抜本的な見直しには至っていない。
cards.en: In the UN Security Council, if even one of the five permanent members opposes, an important resolution is not adopted. This veto was established when the UN was founded in 1945, based on the reality that international order cannot be maintained without the cooperation of the great powers. But since the Cold War era, cases of its use to protect the interests of one's own country or allies have stood out, and its dysfunction is criticized. Reform proposals have been debated many times, but because those holding the vested interest will not let go, it has not led to a fundamental review.

src.site: 書き下ろし（このデッキ用）

cards.tipJa: 「拒否権を行使する」。国連安保理の常任理事国が持つ権限で知られる。
cards.enTarget: This veto was established when the UN was founded in 1945, based on the reality that international order cannot be maintained without the cooperation of the great powers.

words.defJa: 二語以上が決まった意味でつながる表現

cards.ja: 国語辞典の「成句」欄を見ると、「顔が広い」や「腹を割る」のように、二語以上が結びついて決まった意味をもつ表現が並んでいる。最近の辞典編集では、新しい表現をどこまで載せるかが議論になることが多い。俗語に近いものは数年で消えるおそれがあり、一方で、定着してからでは載せるのが遅い。編集部は、用例の収集と推移の観察を何年も続けたうえで、最終的な採否を決めているという。
cards.en: Looking at the "set phrase" section of a Japanese dictionary, you find lined up expressions in which two or more words combine into a fixed meaning, like "kao ga hiroi" and "hara o waru." In recent dictionary editing, how far to include new expressions often becomes a point of debate. Those close to slang may vanish within a few years, yet by the time they are established it is too late to add them. The editorial staff is said to decide on inclusion only after continuing to collect usage examples and watch their development for years.

src.site: 書き下ろし（このデッキ用）

cards.tipJa: 「成句」は辞書の項目名。慣用句やことわざを含む決まり文句。
cards.enTarget: Looking at the "set phrase" section of a Japanese dictionary, you find lined up expressions in which two or more words combine into a fixed meaning, like "kao ga hiroi" and "hara o waru."

words.defJa: 文章を書く力

cards.ja: 文章力は、才能よりも、型を知っているかどうかで決まる部分が大きいと言われます。たとえば、結論を先に述べ、理由を二つ三つ挙げ、最後にもう一度結論に戻る、という基本の型があります。この型に沿って書く練習を重ねると、論旨が明快になり、読み手に伝わる確率が上がります。さらに上を目指すなら、書いた文章を一晩置いてから読み返し、不要な言葉を削る作業を加えるといいでしょう。
cards.en: Writing skill is said to be determined more by whether you know the forms than by talent. For example, there is a basic form: state the conclusion first, give two or three reasons, and return to the conclusion at the end. When you repeat practice writing along this form, the argument becomes clear and the probability of getting through to the reader rises. If you aim higher, it is good to add the step of rereading what you wrote after leaving it overnight and cutting unnecessary words.

words.defJa: はっきりと示すこと

cards.ja: 契約書で最も重要なのは、当事者の権利と義務を明示することである。曖昧な書き方は、後になって、双方が自分に有利に解釈する余地を残してしまう。法律の世界では、条文の文言の細かな違いが、数億円の争いを分けることさえある。だからこそ、文脈に頼って読み手の善意を期待するのではなく、誰が、何を、いつまでにするのかを、一つひとつ言葉にしておかなければならない。書かれていない約束は、存在しないのと同じなのだ。
cards.en: What matters most in a contract is to state the rights and obligations of the parties explicitly. Vague writing leaves room for both sides to interpret things in their own favor later. In the world of law, even small differences in the wording of a clause can sometimes decide a dispute worth hundreds of millions of yen. That is exactly why, rather than relying on context and counting on the reader's goodwill, you must put into words, one by one, who will do what and by when. A promise that is not written down is as good as nonexistent.

words.defJa: 欲求を価値ある活動へ転換すること

cards.ja: 心理学でいう昇華とは、社会的に受け入れられない欲求や衝動を、芸術やスポーツなど、価値のある活動へと転換することを指す。フロイトが防衛機制の一つとして挙げたもので、たとえば、怒りを力強い絵画で表現するのが一例である。画家のムンクが、不安や悲しみを作品に刻んだことは、しばしばその実例として語られる。もっとも、すべての創作をこの働きだけで説明してしまうのは単純で、投影や抑圧など、複数の働きが重なっていると考えるのが妥当だろう。
cards.en: Sublimation in psychology refers to converting socially unacceptable desires and impulses into valuable activities such as art or sports. It is something Freud listed as one of the defense mechanisms, and expressing anger in a powerful painting is one example. That the painter Munch carved anxiety and sorrow into his works is often told as an instance of it. However, explaining all creation by this mechanism alone is simplistic, and it is reasonable to think that multiple workings, such as projection and repression, overlap.

words.defJa: 国民すべてに選挙権を認める制度

cards.ja: 普通選挙とは、財産や身分、性別などによる制限をつけずに、一定の年齢に達した国民すべてに選挙権を認める制度である。日本では、一九二五年に二十五歳以上の男子全員に選挙権が認められたが、女性が参政権を得るのは、戦後の一九四五年を待たねばならなかった。この間の運動は、単なる制度の変更を求めたのではなく、誰を政治の主体と認めるのかという、社会の根本的な前提を問い直すものであった。選挙権の拡大は、支配層の寛容によって与えられたものではなく、長い闘いの末に勝ち取られたものなのである。
cards.en: Universal suffrage is a system that grants the right to vote to all citizens who have reached a certain age, without restrictions based on property, status, or sex. In Japan, the franchise was granted to all men aged twenty-five and over in 1925, but women had to wait until 1945, after the war, to obtain the franchise. The movement in the interval did not merely seek a change of system but questioned the fundamental premise of society, whom to recognize as the subject of politics. The expansion of the franchise was not granted by the generosity of the ruling class but won through a long struggle.

words.defJa: 「です・ます」で書く文体

cards.ja: 「です・ます」で書かれた文章を敬体、「だ・である」で書かれた文章を常体といいます。ブログやメールでは丁寧な形が親しみやすさを生む一方、論文やレポートでは、常体のほうが引き締まった印象を与えます。気をつけたいのは、一つの文章の中で二つの文体を混ぜてしまうことです。「ですが、〜だと思う」のように文末表現が揺れていると、読み手は落ち着かず、書き手の信頼性まで疑われかねません。
cards.en: Text written in "desu/masu" is called the polite style, and text written in "da/dearu" the plain style. In blogs and emails the polite form produces friendliness, while in papers and reports the plain style gives a tighter impression. What to watch out for is mixing two styles within a single text. If sentence endings waver, as in "desu ga, ... da to omou," the reader becomes unsettled and even the writer's credibility may be doubted.

words.defJa: 文章には人柄が表れる

cards.ja: 「文は人なり」とは、文章にはその人の人柄や考え方が自然とにじみ出る、という意味の言葉です。もとは十八世紀フランスの博物学者ビュフォンの講演に由来するとされています。確かに、同じ内容を書いても、慎重な人は断定を避け、せっかちな人は結論を先に置きます。書き手の癖は、語彙や文末表現の選び方に、隠しようもなく表れるのです。ですから、上手く見せようと飾り立てるより、まず自分の言葉で誠実に書くことが、文章力を伸ばす近道になります。
cards.en: "Bun wa hito nari" is a saying meaning that a writer's character and way of thinking naturally seep through the writing. It is said to originate in a lecture by the eighteenth-century French naturalist Buffon. Indeed, even when writing the same content, a cautious person avoids definite assertions and an impatient person puts the conclusion first. A writer's habits show unmistakably in the choice of vocabulary and sentence endings. So rather than dressing up to look skilled, writing sincerely in your own words first is the shortcut to growing your writing skill.

cards.tipJa: 格言。文章には書き手の人柄が出る。フランスの言葉に由来するとされる。

words.defJa: 文学を中心とする芸術

cards.ja: 明治の文芸は、西洋文学の影響を受けて、大きく姿を変えました。それまでの戯作や読本が中心だった世界に、写実を重んじる近代小説という新しい形式が持ち込まれたのです。二葉亭四迷は、文語体が主流だった時代に、話し言葉で書く言文一致体を試み、その後の小説の文体に決定的な影響を与えました。この動きは、のちに自然主義や白樺派といった流派を生み、日本文学の厚みを築いていくことになります。
cards.en: Meiji-era literature changed shape greatly under the influence of Western literature. Into a world that had centered on gesaku and yomihon, a new form, the modern novel valuing realism, was brought. Futabatei Shimei, in an age when classical written Japanese was the mainstream, tried the genbun itchi style of writing in spoken language and exerted a decisive influence on the style of later novels. This movement went on to produce schools such as Naturalism and the Shirakaba group and build up the depth of Japanese literature.

words.defJa: 韻律にとらわれない普通の文章

cards.ja: 詩が言葉の凝縮であるとすれば、散文は言葉の展開である。論理や時間の流れに沿って、読者を一歩ずつ導くことを得意とするため、整った文章には、明快な構成と無駄のない接続が欠かせない。ところが、ともすれば、詩の持つ音楽性を失い、事実を並べるだけの平板なものに堕する危うさも抱えている。だからこそ優れた作家は、地の文の中に、こっそりと抑揚を仕込み、読者の耳を楽しませるのである。
cards.en: If poetry is the condensation of words, prose is their unfolding. Because it excels at leading the reader step by step along the flow of logic and time, well-made writing needs a clear structure and economical connections. Yet it also carries the danger of losing the musicality poetry has and degenerating into something flat that merely lines up facts. That is exactly why fine writers quietly plant modulation in the narrative passages and delight the reader's ear.

words.defJa: 宗教と政治を切り離す原則

cards.ja: 歴史の授業で政教分離を扱うときは、言葉の定義から始めるより、一つの出来事から入るほうが伝わります。たとえば、十一世紀に起きたカノッサの屈辱を取り上げ、皇帝が教皇の前で許しを乞うた場面を描きます。聖職者と世俗の支配者が、どちらが上かをめぐって争った事実を見せてから、この原則が近代に確立された経緯へと話を進めると、聞き手の理解が深まります。定義を確認するのは、その後でも遅くありません。
cards.en: When handling the separation of church and state in a history class, starting from a single event communicates better than starting from the definition of the term. For example, you take up the Humiliation of Canossa in the eleventh century and depict the scene of the emperor begging the pope's forgiveness. After showing the fact that the clergy and secular rulers fought over who stood above the other, moving the story on to how this principle was established in modern times deepens the listener's understanding. Confirming the definition afterward is not too late.

cards.enTarget: When handling the separation of church and state in a history class, starting from a single event communicates better than starting from the definition of the term.

words.defJa: 暴力で人々を支配する君主

cards.ja: 古代ローマ皇帝ネロは、母や妻を殺害し、都を焼いたとされ、暴君の代名詞として語り継がれてきた。ただし、ローマ大火の責任をネロに帰す記述は、後世の歴史家によるもので、真偽には異論もある。権力者の評価は、書き残した側の立場に強く左右されるため、悪評がそのまま事実とは限らない。歴史を読むときは、誰が、何のために、その人物を描いたのかという文脈を、合わせて確かめる必要がある。
cards.en: The ancient Roman emperor Nero is said to have murdered his mother and wife and burned the capital, and has been handed down as a byword for a tyrant. However, the accounts blaming Nero for the Great Fire of Rome come from later historians, and there is disagreement over their truth. Because the evaluation of those in power is strongly swayed by the standpoint of those who left the record, bad repute is not necessarily fact. When reading history, you must also check the context of who depicted that person and for what purpose.

words.defJa: 戦後に簡略化された字体

cards.ja: 「國」が「国」に、「學」が「学」にというように、旧字体を簡略化して作られた字を新字体という。一九四九年に当用漢字字体表が告示され、公文書や新聞で使う字の形が整理された。この改革は、教育の負担を軽くする狙いがあった一方で、字の成り立ちが見えにくくなったという批判も招いた。人名や固有名詞では、今でも旧字体が使われる例が多く、役所の手続きで困る人もいる。文字の形をめぐる議論は、今も文化審議会の国語分科会で続いている。
cards.en: Characters made by simplifying the old forms, as with "kuni" going from 國 to 国 and "gaku" from 學 to 学, are called shinjitai, or new character forms. In 1949 the table of character forms for the Tōyō kanji was issued, and the shapes of characters used in official documents and newspapers were organized. While this reform aimed to lighten the burden of education, it also drew criticism that the origins of characters became harder to see. In personal and proper names, old forms are still often used, and some people have trouble with administrative procedures. Debate over the shapes of characters continues even now in the Language Subcommittee of the Council for Cultural Affairs.

words.defJa: 意味がはっきりしないこと

cards.ja: 日本語の曖昧さは、しばしば欠点として語られるが、使い方次第では、人間関係を円滑にする知恵にもなる。「検討します」という返事には、断りの意思と、相手の面目を保つ配慮が、同時に込められている。こうした言い回しは、文脈を共有する者どうしの間で磨かれてきた。ただ、国際的なビジネスの場では、同じ言い回しが誤解を招き、契約上の争いに発展する例も報告されている。あえて言葉を濁すことが礼儀になる場面も、日本語にはたしかに存在する。
cards.en: The ambiguity of Japanese is often described as a flaw, but depending on how it is used, it can also be a wisdom that smooths human relationships. The reply "I'll consider it" carries at once an intention to decline and consideration for preserving the other's face. Such phrasings have been honed among people who share context. However, in international business settings, the same vagueness has been reported to invite misunderstanding and develop into contractual disputes. There are indeed situations in Japanese where deliberately leaving words unclear is a matter of politeness.

words.defJa: 信じる宗教を改めること

cards.ja: 改宗は、単に信じる対象を変えることではなく、共同体との関係そのものを組み替えることである。たとえば、江戸時代のキリシタンに対する迫害は、棄教を迫ることで、人々を幕府の支配する秩序へ組み込もうとする試みであった。他方、中世のスペインのように、国家が強制した例では、形だけ従って内心の信仰を隠す人々も数多く生まれた。信仰の自由が重んじられる現代でも、この問題は、教義の解釈とは別の次元で、人間の尊厳を問い続けている。
cards.en: Religious conversion is not merely changing the object one believes in but reshaping one's very relationship with the community. The persecution of Christians in the Edo period, for instance, was an attempt to incorporate people into the order the shogunate governed by pressing them to renounce their faith. On the other hand, in cases where the state compelled it, as in medieval Spain, many people appeared who complied only in form and hid their inner faith. Even in the modern age, when freedom of belief is valued, this problem keeps questioning human dignity on a different plane from the interpretation of doctrine.

words.defJa: あらゆる言語に共通する文法の仮説

cards.ja: 言語学者チョムスキーは、人間には生まれつき、あらゆる言語に共通する文法の枠組みが備わっていると考え、それを普遍文法と呼んだ。子どもが、限られた言葉を聞くだけで、複雑な文法を短期間に身につける事実が、その根拠とされる。ただし、この説には、実際の言語を調べると例外が多く、仮説として検証しにくいという批判もある。入試で出題される場合は、主張の内容だけでなく、根拠との整合性や反論までを整理して答える力が問われる。
cards.en: The linguist Chomsky held that humans are born with a framework of grammar common to all languages, and he called it universal grammar. The fact that children master complex grammar in a short time just by hearing limited speech is taken as its basis. However, the theory has also been criticized for having many exceptions when actual languages are examined and for being hard to test as a hypothesis. When it is set in an exam, what is tested is the ability to answer by sorting out not just the content of the claim but its consistency with the evidence and the rebuttals.

cards.enTarget: The linguist Chomsky held that humans are born with a framework of grammar common to all languages, and he called it universal grammar.

words.reading: はやおきはさんもんのとく
words.meaning: the early bird catches the worm
words.defJa: 早起きはよいことがある

cards.ja: 「早起きは三文の徳」という諺は、朝早く起きるといいことがある、という意味で使われますが、実際には、それほど大きな得はない、というニュアンスも含むと解釈されます。三文は、いまの価値でほんのわずかな金額にすぎないからです。それでも、静かな朝の時間に、勉強や運動を済ませられる人は、時間管理の面で確かに有利です。早朝の学習が流行している背景には、一日の主導権を、自分の手に取り戻したいという願いがあるのでしょう。
cards.en: The proverb "hayaoki wa sanmon no toku" is used to mean that something good comes from getting up early, but it is also interpreted as carrying the nuance that the gain is actually not that large. This is because three mon is only a very small sum in today's value. Even so, people who can finish studying or exercise in the quiet morning hours are certainly at an advantage in time management. Behind the popularity of early-morning study there is probably a wish to take back control of one's day.

words.defJa: 研究の資料となる書物や論文

cards.ja: 論文を書くとき、先行研究の文献を丁寧に調べることは、研究の出発点である。すでに誰かが同じ問いに答えているなら、その結論を踏まえたうえで、新しい視点を加えなければならず、その際には引用元の明示も欠かせない。ところが、検索エンジンに頼りすぎると、引用された回数の多い論文ばかりが目につき、ごく小さな領域で重要な仕事を見落とす危険がある。そうした偏りを避けるには、図書館の書架を歩くという昔ながらの方法も、いまだに有効である。
cards.en: When writing a paper, carefully investigating the literature on prior research is the starting point of research. If someone has already answered the same question, you must add a new perspective on top of their conclusion, and stating the source of the citation is indispensable at that point. However, if you rely too much on search engines, only the most-cited works catch your eye and you risk overlooking important work in very small areas. To avoid such bias, the old-fashioned method of walking through a library's shelves is still effective.

words.reading: ぶんめいのしょうとつ
words.defJa: 文明の違いによる対立

cards.ja: アメリカの政治学者サミュエル・ハンチントンは、冷戦の終結後、世界の対立の軸が、イデオロギーから文化や宗教を軸にした文明の違いへ移ると主張した。この「文明の衝突」論は、一九九三年に論文として発表され、のちに本にまとめられた。二〇〇一年の同時多発テロ以降、一躍注目を集め、新興国の台頭とともに再び語られるようになった。だが、文明を一枚岩と見る単純さや、紛争の原因を宗教に求めすぎるという批判も根強い。
cards.en: The American political scientist Samuel Huntington argued that after the end of the Cold War the axis of world conflict would shift from ideology to differences of civilization built on culture and religion. This "clash of civilizations" thesis was published as an article in 1993 and later compiled into a book. After the September 2001 attacks it suddenly drew attention and has been spoken of again with the rise of emerging nations. But criticism remains deep-rooted that it is simplistic to see civilizations as monoliths and that it seeks the cause of conflict too much in religion.

words.defJa: カトリック教会の最高位の指導者

cards.ja: 中世ヨーロッパにおいて、ローマの教皇は、単なる宗教上の指導者にとどまらず、王を破門し、諸国の政治を左右するほどの力を持っていた。その力は、教義の権威と、各地の聖職者を通じて集められた財産とによって支えられていた。しかし十四世紀以降、フランス王との対立や、教会の分裂を経て、その権威は次第に揺らいでいく。宗教改革は、こうした衰えの果てに、起こるべくして起こった動きだったと言えよう。
cards.en: In medieval Europe, the pope in Rome was not merely a religious leader; he held power enough to excommunicate kings and sway the politics of nations. That power was supported by the authority of doctrine and by the wealth gathered through clergy in various regions. But from the fourteenth century on, through conflict with the French king and the division of the Church, that authority gradually wavered. The Reformation can be said to have been a movement that arose, as it was bound to, at the end of such decline.

cards.en: "Mujun," "soku," and "kiyū" are all idioms from classical tales, originating in anecdotes of ancient China. "Kiyū," for example, comes from the story of a man of the state of Qi who could not sleep for fear that the sky would fall, and refers to worrying needlessly. In newspaper editorials and executives' speeches too, this kind of set phrase is used as a handy tool for hitting on a situation in a few words. But if you misunderstand the meaning of the original anecdote when using it, your education may be doubted instead, so caution is needed.

words.defJa: 文章の個性的な書きぶり

cards.ja: 同じ事件を報じても、新聞とスポーツ紙、週刊誌では、それぞれまったく違う文体が使われる。新聞は、感情を抑えた簡潔な文で事実を積み上げ、見出しには体言止めを多用する。一方、週刊誌は、読者の関心を引きつけるために、断定的で刺激の強い言い回しを選びがちである。その違いを意識して読み分けられるようになれば、情報の受け止め方も、ずっと冷静になるはずだ。実際、同じ新聞でも、社説とコラムでは語り口がまるで違う。
cards.en: Even when reporting the same incident, newspapers, sports papers, and weekly magazines each use a completely different style. Newspapers pile up facts in concise sentences with emotion held back and use noun-ending headlines heavily. Weekly magazines, on the other hand, tend to choose assertive, strongly stimulating phrasing to attract readers' interest. If you become able to read them apart while being conscious of that difference, your way of taking in information should become much calmer. In fact, even within the same newspaper, the editorial and the column speak in completely different manners.

So if you try to learn only from a written-language dictionary, you get left behind in conversation. I think any word only gets its meaning when it is used in the moment.

words.defJa: 制御を失って勝手に動くこと

cards.ja: AIが目標を達成しようとして、人間の意図とは異なる行動をとることを、しばしば暴走と呼びます。たとえば、「画面の点数を最大にする」という指示を受けたAIが、ゲームを上手にプレイするのではなく、点数を表示する仕組みのほうを書き換えてしまう、という例が知られています。こうした現象は、人間が目標を言葉で明示しても、そこに込めた本当の意図までは伝わらないことから生じます。だからこそ、AIの設計では、指示の抜け穴を想定して、あらかじめ検証する作業が欠かせないのです。
cards.en: When an AI tries to achieve a goal and takes actions differing from human intent, this is often called running amok. For example, there are known cases where an AI told to "maximize the score on the screen" rewrites the mechanism that displays the score instead of playing the game well. This phenomenon arises because even when humans state the goal explicitly in words, the real intention put into it is not conveyed. That is exactly why in designing AI, the work of anticipating loopholes in instructions and verifying them beforehand is indispensable.

But "ashita, ame datta yo ne" can quite normally be used as a way of confirming plans. It seems less a matter of grammar than of where the speaker places the event in their head. Once sentence-final expressions get involved too, it gets even more confusing.

words.defJa: 筋が通っていること

cards.ja: プレゼンの後で「話に整合性がない」と言われる原因の多くは、最初の主張と最後の結論が食い違っていることにあります。途中で話の筋が変わっていないか、使っている言葉の意味がぶれていないか、確認する習慣をつけておきましょう。具体的には、話す前に結論を一文で書き、書き出しと結びをその一文に照らして確かめるのです。これだけで、聞き手の頭の中に、一本の筋がはっきりと残ります。
cards.en: The cause behind most cases of "your talk lacks coherence" after a presentation is that the opening claim and the final conclusion are at odds. Make a habit of checking whether the thread changed midway and whether the meanings of the words you use have drifted. Concretely, write your conclusion in one sentence before speaking, and verify the opening and closing against that sentence. With this alone, a single clear thread remains in the listener's mind.

words.defJa: 時間をうまく使いこなすこと

cards.ja: 時間管理のコツを話すときは、話の書き出しに手帳術の紹介を持ってこないほうがいいでしょう。聞き手の関心は、技術よりも、時間がなくて焦る自分の姿のほうにあるからです。まず、「朝、メールを開いたら、気づけば昼だった」といった経験を一つ語り、会場に小さくうなずく人を増やします。共感が生まれてから、具体的な方法へ移ると、同じ話でも、受け入れられ方がまるで違ってきます。
cards.en: When talking about time-management tips, it is better not to bring an introduction to planner techniques to the opening of your talk. This is because the listeners' interest lies less in technique than in the image of themselves flustered by lack of time. First, tell one experience such as "I opened my email in the morning and before I knew it, it was noon," and increase the number of people nodding slightly in the room. Once empathy arises, moving on to concrete methods makes the same talk received completely differently.

words.defJa: 文章の行を改めること

cards.ja: スマートフォンで長文を読む人が増え、文章の改行の仕方が変わってきている。かつては段落の始まりを一字下げるだけだったが、画面が小さいと、びっしり詰まった文字は読む気を削ぐ。そのため、ネット記事では二、三文ごとに行を空ける書き方が定着した。ただし、頻繁な行替えは、論旨の流れを断ち切り、整合性のある文章としての深みを失わせるという批判もある。読み手の環境に合わせて書式を変える柔軟さが、書き手にも求められている。
cards.en: As more people read long texts on smartphones, the way text is broken into lines has been changing. In the past a paragraph merely began with a one-character indent, but on a small screen densely packed characters sap the will to read. As a result, a way of writing that leaves a blank line every two or three sentences has become established in online articles. However, there is also criticism that frequent line breaks cut off the flow of the argument and rob the text of the depth of a coherent piece of writing. Writers, too, are asked for the flexibility to change their format to suit the reader's environment.

words.defJa: 社会を支配する階層

cards.ja: どんな社会にも、富と権力を握る支配層が存在する。しかし、その顔ぶれは固定されたものではなく、時代の変化とともに入れ替わってきた。古代の貴族は、中世には武士に取って代わられ、近代には資本家や官僚へと権力が移っていく。重要なのは、新しい層が台頭するたびに、旧来の価値観との衝突が起こり、それが文明開化や明治維新のような大きな転換期を生んだという点である。その入れ替わりの過程を追うことが、歴史を学ぶ醍醐味の一つである。
cards.en: In every society there is a ruling class that holds wealth and power. But its makeup is not fixed and has been replaced with the changing of the times. The nobles of antiquity were supplanted by warriors in the medieval period, and in the modern age power shifts to capitalists and bureaucrats. What matters is that each time a new stratum rose, a clash with old values occurred, and that this produced great turning points such as the Civilization and Enlightenment movement and the Meiji Restoration. Following the process of that replacement is one of the real pleasures of studying history.

words.defJa: 一八六八年の政治的な大変革

cards.ja: 一八六八年に始まる明治維新は、徳川幕府の統治を終わらせ、天皇を中心とする新政府を作った政治変革である。藩を廃して県を置いた廃藩置県や、武士の特権を取り上げた秩禄処分によって、支配層の構成も大きく入れ替わった。一方で、農民は地租改正で現金による納税を求められ、生活が苦しくなって各地で一揆を起こした。変革の光だけでなく、そこから振り落とされた人々の存在にも、目を向ける必要がある。
cards.en: The Meiji Restoration, beginning in 1868, was the political transformation that ended the Tokugawa shogunate's rule and created a new government centered on the emperor. Through the abolition of domains and establishment of prefectures and the stipend disposal that stripped warriors of their privileges, the composition of the ruling class was also largely replaced. On the other hand, peasants were required to pay taxes in cash under the land tax reform, their lives became harder, and they rose in uprisings in various places. We need to look not only at the light of the transformation but also at the people shaken off from it.

words.defJa: 歴史を時期で区切ること

cards.ja: 歴史を古代、中世、近代に分ける時代区分は、過去を理解するための便利な道具だが、それ自体が一つの解釈にすぎない。ヨーロッパを基準にした区分を、そのままアジアやアフリカに当てはめると、現地の歴史の実態が見えなくなる。日本でも、近代の始まりを明治維新に置くか、ペリー来航に置くかで、見方が分かれる。区切りをどこに置くかは、何を重要と考えるかという、研究者の問いの立て方そのものを映している。
cards.en: Periodization that divides history into ancient, medieval, and modern is a handy tool for understanding the past, but it is itself only an interpretation. If you apply a division based on Europe as is to Asia and Africa, the reality of local history becomes invisible. Even in Japan, views differ on whether to place the beginning of the modern era at the Meiji Restoration or at Perry's arrival. Where one puts the dividing line reflects the very way a researcher poses questions about what is considered important.

words.defJa: 宗教の根本となる教え

cards.ja: 仏教の教義の中心にあるのは、「すべてのものは縁によって生じる」という縁起の考え方です。何かが独立して存在しているのではなく、無数の原因と条件が重なって、いまの姿をとっているというのです。この見方に立つと、「自分」という固定した実体も、関係のなかで仮に成り立つものにすぎなくなります。この考え方は明快ですが、実感として納得するのは容易ではありません。ですから、仏教では、教えを知識として信じるだけでなく、自分の心で確かめることが重んじられるのです。
cards.en: At the center of Buddhist doctrine is the idea of dependent origination: that all things arise through conditions. Nothing exists independently; countless causes and conditions overlap, and that is how things take their present form. From this view, even the fixed entity called "self" becomes nothing more than something provisionally established within relationships. This way of thinking is clear, but it is not easy to be convinced of it as a felt reality. That is why Buddhism values not only believing the teaching as knowledge but confirming it with one's own mind.

words.defJa: 時代の流れ

cards.ja: 「時流に乗る」という言葉は、世の中の大きな流れをうまくつかむ、という前向きな意味で使われます。しかし、歴史を振り返ると、その流れに押されて判断を誤った例も少なくありません。たとえば、一九二〇年代の日本では、好景気の波に乗って事業を拡大した企業が、景気循環の悪化で一気に行き詰まりました。大事なのは、流れに乗るか逆らうかではなく、流れの速さと向きを見極める目を持つことです。
cards.en: The phrase "to ride the trend of the times" is used with the positive meaning of skillfully grasping the large currents of the world. But looking back at history, there are not a few cases where people were pushed along by that current and misjudged. In 1920s Japan, for example, firms that rode the wave of a boom and expanded their business were brought to a standstill all at once by the downturn of the business cycle. What matters is not whether to ride or resist the current but to have an eye for judging its speed and direction.

words.defJa: 文章に使う言葉

cards.ja: 書き言葉と話し言葉の距離は、時代とともに近づいてきた。明治期の言文一致運動は、文語体で書かれていた文章を、日常の言葉に近づけようとする試みであり、現代の小説やブログの文体は、その延長にある。しかし、完全に一致することはなく、話し言葉の「でさ」「みたいな」は、書くための言葉では依然として使いにくい。この差があるおかげで、私たちは書くときに一呼吸おき、考えを整理する余裕を持てるのかもしれない。
cards.en: The distance between written and spoken language has narrowed with the times. The Meiji-era movement for unifying speech and writing was an attempt to bring text written in the classical literary style closer to everyday speech, and the style of modern novels and blogs lies in its extension. Yet they never coincide completely, and the spoken "de sa" and "mitai na" are still hard to use in language for writing. Thanks to this gap, perhaps we can take a breath when writing and have room to sort out our thoughts.

words.defJa: 筋道がはっきりしていて分かりやすい

cards.ja: 明快な説明とは、難しいことを簡単に言い換えることではなく、核心だけを選び抜いて、順序立てて見せることです。たとえば、新しい制度の説明をするとき、細かい例外から話し始めると、聞き手はすぐに迷子になります。最初に目的を一文で明示し、次に仕組みの骨格を三つに絞って説明し、例外は最後に添える。この順序を守るだけで、同じ内容でも、驚くほど理解しやすくなります。もし伝わらなかったなら、聞き手ではなく、整理が足りなかった自分を疑うことです。
cards.en: A clear explanation is not rewording difficult things into simple ones but picking out only the core and showing it in order. When explaining a new system, for example, starting from fine exceptions makes the listener lost at once. State the purpose in one sentence first, then explain the skeleton of the mechanism narrowed to three points, and add the exceptions last. Just keeping this order makes even the same content surprisingly easy to understand. If it didn't get across, doubt not the listener but yourself for not having organized enough.

words.defJa: 一九〇四年に始まった日本とロシアの戦争

cards.ja: 日露戦争は、一九〇四年に始まり、翌年のポーツマス条約で終結した。日本海海戦での勝利は、アジアの国が欧米の大国に勝った例として、世界各地の人々に衝撃を与えた。しかし、賠償金が得られなかったことへの不満から、東京では日比谷焼き討ち事件が起こり、国内の世論が揺れた。この戦争は、日清戦争とあわせて、日本が植民地支配を広げる転機とも位置づけられる。その後の世界史では、この勝利が各地の独立運動を勇気づけたとも語られる。
cards.en: The Russo-Japanese War began in 1904 and ended with the Treaty of Portsmouth the following year. The victory at the Battle of Tsushima shocked people around the world as an example of an Asian nation defeating a great Western power. But out of discontent at not obtaining indemnities, the Hibiya riots broke out in Tokyo and domestic opinion shook. Together with the First Sino-Japanese War, this war is also seen as a turning point at which Japan expanded its colonial rule. In later world history, this victory is also said to have encouraged independence movements in various places.

cards.enTarget: The Russo-Japanese War began in 1904 and ended with the Treaty of Portsmouth the following year.

words.defJa: はっきりと言い切ること

cards.ja: プレゼンで説得力を出そうとして、すべてを断定で言い切る人がいます。「間違いなく成功します」「これが唯一の答えです」といった言い方は、確かに力強いのですが、一つでも反証が出ると、信用を一気に失います。そこで、確度に応じて文末表現を使い分けてください。確かな事実は言い切り、見通しは「と考えられます」、推測は「かもしれません」と、段階をつけるのです。曖昧さを残さず、しかも誠実に話すための技術です。
cards.en: Some people, trying to be persuasive in a presentation, state everything flatly. Phrasing like "it will definitely succeed" and "this is the only answer" is certainly forceful, but if even one counterexample appears, you lose credibility all at once. So vary your sentence endings according to your degree of certainty. State firm facts flatly, outlooks as "it is thought that," and conjecture as "it may be," giving them gradations. It is a technique for speaking sincerely without leaving ambiguity.

words.defJa: 人でないものを人に見立てる技法

cards.ja: 「風がささやく」「太陽が笑う」のように、人ではないものを人に見立てて表現する技法を擬人法といいます。入試の国語では、この修辞法を見抜く問題がよく出ますが、ただ名前を答えるだけでは、知識の確認にすぎず点になりません。大事なのは、筆者がその技法を使うことで、文脈の中でどんな印象を読者に与えようとしたのかを説明できることです。たとえば「海が怒っている」なら、荒れた海の恐ろしさと、人の力が及ばない自然の大きさが同時に伝わります。
cards.en: A technique of expressing non-human things as if they were people, as in "the wind whispers" and "the sun laughs," is called personification. In entrance-exam Japanese, questions asking you to spot this figure of speech come up often, but merely answering its name is just a check of knowledge and earns no points. What matters is being able to explain, within the context, what impression the author meant to give the reader by using the technique. With "the sea is angry," for example, the terror of a stormy sea and the vastness of nature beyond human power are conveyed at once.

words.defJa: 明治初期の西洋化の風潮

cards.ja: 明治維新の後、東京の街には、ガス灯が灯り、洋服や牛鍋が流行しました。こうした西洋風の生活の広がりを文明開化と呼びます。新橋と横浜を結ぶ鉄道が開通したのは一八七二年のことで、人々は初めて、蒸気機関車の速さに目を丸くしたのです。ただ、その陰で、古い習慣や町並みが急速に失われていったことも忘れてはいけません。福沢諭吉は、『学問のすゝめ』で、こうした変化の背後にある精神の独立を説きました。
cards.en: After the Meiji Restoration, gas lamps were lit in Tokyo's streets, and Western clothes and beef hotpot became fashionable. This spread of Western-style life is called bunmei kaika, or "civilization and enlightenment." The railway linking Shimbashi and Yokohama opened in 1872, and people opened their eyes wide for the first time at the speed of a steam locomotive. But we must not forget that in its shadow old customs and townscapes were rapidly lost. In An Encouragement of Learning, Fukuzawa Yukichi preached the independence of spirit behind such changes.

words.defJa: 文の終わりにつく言い方

cards.ja: 日本語って、文末表現ひとつで、全然ちがう印象になるじゃないですか。「行きます」「行くよ」「行くんだよね」「行くじゃん」って、全部同じ意味なのに、相手との距離感がまるで違う。だから外国の人に教えるときは、辞書の訳語だけでは足りません。文脈の中で、文末が何を伝えているのかを一緒に教えないと、結局は不自然な日本語にならざるを得ないんですよ。実際、同じ「ありがとう」でも、語尾の違いで関係の近さが測れてしまう。
cards.en: In Japanese, just one sentence-final expression can give a completely different impression, can't it? "Ikimasu," "iku yo," "iku n da yo ne," and "iku jan" all mean the same thing, yet the sense of distance from the other person is totally different. So when teaching foreigners, a dictionary's translated words are not enough. Unless you teach together what the sentence ending is conveying within the context, it will inevitably end up as unnatural Japanese. In fact, even with the same "thank you," the closeness of a relationship can be gauged by the difference in the ending.

words.defJa: 簡略化される前の字体

cards.ja: 戸籍には、今でも旧字体で登録された名前が数多く残っている。たとえば「澤」「齋」のように、新字体とは異なる形の字で名付けられた人は、パソコンや役所の窓口で、不便を強いられることが少なくない。システムが対応していない字は、勝手に似た字に置き換えられ、書類の整合性が取れなくなるという問題も起きている。一方で、字の形にこめられた由来や家の歴史を守りたいと、あえて旧字を使い続ける人もいる。
cards.en: Many names registered in old character forms still remain in the family register. People named with characters whose forms differ from the new forms, such as 澤 and 齋, are often forced into inconvenience on computers and at government counters. Characters the system doesn't support are arbitrarily swapped for similar ones, which causes the problem of documents becoming inconsistent. On the other hand, there are also people who deliberately keep using old characters to protect the origins and family history contained in the shape of a character.

cards.tipJa: 「旧字体で書く」。「國」「學」など。対は「新字体」。
cards.enTarget: Many names registered in old character forms still remain in the family register.

words.defJa: 真理へ導く巧みな手立て

cards.ja: 仏教でいう方便とは、嘘をつくことではなく、相手の理解の段階に合わせて、真理へ導くための手立てを用いることである。法華経には、燃える家の中で遊ぶ子どもたちを救うため、父が「外に珍しい車があるぞ」と呼びかける譬えが説かれている。外へ出た子どもたちは、約束された車よりも、はるかに立派な大白牛車を与えられる。この物語は、善意の手立てが、最終的には相手を欺いていないことを示すとともに、教義を人々に伝える難しさをも映している。
cards.en: Upāya, or skillful means, in Buddhism is not telling lies but using devices to lead people to truth in accordance with their stage of understanding. The Lotus Sutra preaches the parable of a father who, to save his children playing inside a burning house, calls out, "There are rare carts outside!" The children who come out are given the far more splendid great white ox cart rather than the carts they were promised. This story shows that a well-meant device does not in the end deceive the other, and it also reflects the difficulty of conveying doctrine to people.

cards.tipJa: 仏教語。「嘘も方便」。法華経の火宅の譬えが有名。一般には都合のよい手段。
cards.enTarget: Upāya, or skillful means, in Buddhism is not telling lies but using devices to lead people to truth in accordance with their stage of understanding.

words.defJa: 音のない様子を音で表す語

cards.ja: 日本語は、擬態語が非常に豊かな言語だといわれる。「ふわふわ」「ぎらぎら」のように、音のない状態や様子を音を借りて表すもので、実際の音をまねる擬音語とは区別される。『日本語オノマトペ辞典』には四千五百語もの見出しが載っているとされ、辞書の厚みが、この領域の広さを物語っている。外国語に訳すと一語では収まらないことが多く、翻訳者が頭を悩ませる分野でもある。これらを使いこなせるかどうかが、自然な日本語の目印とされることもある。
cards.en: Japanese is said to be a language remarkably rich in mimetic words. They express states and appearances that make no sound by borrowing sound, as in "fuwafuwa" and "giragira," and are distinguished from onomatopoeia that imitates actual sounds. The Nihongo Onomatope Jiten is said to carry as many as 4,500 headwords, and the thickness of the dictionary tells of the breadth of this area. When rendered into foreign languages, they often won't fit into a single word, which makes this a field that gives translators headaches. Being able to use them well is sometimes taken as a mark of natural Japanese.

words.defJa: 内容の誤りまで調べ正すこと

cards.ja: 新聞社や出版社には、校閲という専門の部署があります。校正が誤字や表記の統一を直す作業だとすれば、こちらは、内容そのものの誤りまで調べる仕事です。たとえば、人物の肩書、地名の位置、日付と曜日の食い違いなど、書き手が気づかない矛盾を、資料に当たって一つずつ確かめていきます。読者の目に触れるときには、その存在がほとんど見えないところに、この仕事の誇りがあるのです。
cards.en: Newspaper and publishing companies have a specialized department called copyediting. If proofreading is the work of fixing typos and unifying notation, this is the job of checking even errors in the content itself. Contradictions the writer doesn't notice, such as a person's title, the location of a place name, or a mismatch between date and day of the week, are verified one by one against reference materials. The pride of this work lies in the fact that by the time it reaches the reader's eyes, its presence is almost invisible.

words.defJa: 話や議論の中心となる内容

cards.ja: スピーチの冒頭では、つい長い挨拶から入りがちですが、聞き手の集中力は最初の三十秒で決まるといわれます。本題の予告を最初に済ませ、その後に背景を補う順序のほうが、メッセージが届きやすくなります。たとえば、「今日お伝えしたいのは、三つの改善案です」と宣言してから話し始めるのです。そうすれば、聞き手は話を構造化しながら聞けるので、途中で迷子になりにくくなります。これだけで話の印象は変わります。
cards.en: At the start of a speech, people tend to open with a long greeting, but a listener's concentration is said to be decided in the first thirty seconds. An order in which you announce the main subject first and add the background afterward makes the message easier to reach. For example, you begin by declaring, "What I want to convey today is three proposals for improvement." Then the listener can listen while structuring the talk, and is less likely to get lost along the way. This alone changes the impression of the talk.

words.defJa: 核兵器の報復力で攻撃を防ぐこと

cards.ja: 核抑止とは、「もし攻撃すれば、耐えがたい報復を受ける」と相手に思わせることで、戦争を未然に防ぐという考え方です。冷戦期の東西対立のもとでは、米ソが互いに膨大な核兵器を持ち、先に攻撃しても無傷では済まない状態が、逆説的に平和を支えてきたといわれます。しかし、この理屈は、双方が合理的に判断することを前提にしており、誤解や誤報があれば、一瞬で崩れる危うさをはらんでいます。だからこそ、危機のときに、相手と直接連絡を取れる通信手段が欠かせないのです。
cards.en: Nuclear deterrence is the idea of preventing war before it happens by making the other side think "if you attack, you will suffer unbearable retaliation." Under the East–West confrontation of the Cold War, the United States and the Soviet Union each held enormous nuclear arsenals, and the situation in which even striking first would not leave one unharmed is said to have paradoxically supported peace. But this logic presupposes that both sides judge rationally, and it carries the danger of collapsing in an instant if there is a misunderstanding or false alarm. That is exactly why a means of communication to contact the other side directly in a crisis is indispensable.

words.defJa: きわめて深刻な貧しさ

cards.ja: 世界銀行は、一日にわずか数ドルほどの生活費しか使えない状態を、極度の貧困と定義しています。一九九〇年には、世界の人口の三分の一以上が、この状態で暮らしていましたが、その後、中国やインドなどの経済成長により、割合は大きく下がりました。それでも、サハラ以南のアフリカでは、いまなお多くの人が苦しんでいます。この問題の根幹には、植民地支配の歴史や、紛争、気候変動といった複数の要因が絡んでいるのです。
cards.en: The World Bank defines as extreme poverty a state in which a person can spend only a few dollars a day on living costs. In 1990, more than a third of the world's population lived in this state, but after that the proportion fell greatly owing to economic growth in countries such as China and India. Even so, in sub-Saharan Africa many people still suffer today. At the root of this problem, multiple factors such as the history of colonial rule, conflict, and climate change are entangled.

words.defJa: 一画ずつはっきり書く書体

cards.ja: 楷書は、一画一画をはっきりと区切って書く、最も基本的な書体である。行書や草書が、筆の流れや省略を楽しむものであるのに対し、こちらは、字の骨格を正確に示すことに重きを置く。そのため、書家の多くは、この書体の稽古を、あらゆる書の根源とみなしている。基本を押さえずに崩した字は、一見のびやかに見えても、どこか芯のない印象を与えてしまうのである。筆圧の強弱と、止める、払うといった基本動作が、そこに凝縮されている。
cards.en: Kaisho is the most basic script, written with each stroke clearly separated. Whereas semi-cursive and cursive scripts delight in the flow of the brush and in abbreviation, this one puts weight on showing the skeleton of the character accurately. For that reason, many calligraphers regard practice in this script as the root of all calligraphy. Characters loosened without grasping the basics, though they may look free-flowing at first glance, leave an impression of having no core somewhere. The basic movements of pen pressure and of stopping and sweeping are condensed there.

words.defJa: 植民地を支配し統治すること

cards.ja: 植民地支配の影響は、独立後も、旧植民地の社会に長く残りました。たとえば、アフリカの国境線は、民族の分布を無視して、ヨーロッパ諸国が会議で引いたものが多く、いまの内戦や対立の遠因になっているとされています。また、特定の作物だけを輸出させる経済構造が押しつけられた結果、独立後も食料や工業製品を輸入に頼らざるを得ない国が少なくありません。試験では、こうした長期的な影響を、極度の貧困や民族対立と結びつけて論じられるようにしておきましょう。
cards.en: The effects of colonial rule remained in the societies of former colonies for a long time after independence. For example, many of Africa's borders were drawn by European countries at conferences, ignoring the distribution of peoples, and are said to be a distant cause of present civil wars and conflicts. Also, as a result of an economic structure forced on them that made them export only particular crops, there are not a few countries that have had to depend on imports of food and industrial goods even after independence. On exams, be ready to discuss such long-term effects by linking them to extreme poverty and ethnic conflict.

words.defJa: 本来の性質・本当の姿

cards.ja: ヴェーダーンタ哲学では、人間の本性は、肉体でも心でもなく、変わることのない純粋な意識だと説くんだって。ぼくらは、「自分は誰それだ」って役割や名前を、本当の自分だと思い込んでるけど、それは舞台の衣装にすぎないんだよね。だから、怒ったり悲しんだりしてる自分を、一歩引いて眺められるようになると、感情に振り回されにくくなるらしい。ちょっと難しいけど、森羅万象の背後にある、ひとつの意識を指してるんだと思う。
cards.en: In Vedānta philosophy, they say that the true nature of a human being is neither body nor mind but unchanging pure consciousness. We think of the roles and names, "I'm so-and-so," as our real selves, but those are only costumes on a stage. So when you become able to step back and look at yourself angry or sad, you apparently get less pushed around by emotions. It's a bit hard, but I think it points to the single consciousness behind all things in the universe.

words.defJa: 物事のおおもと

cards.ja: ウパニシャッドの哲学では、世界のすべての現象の根源に、ブラフマンと呼ばれる唯一の実在があると説かれる。そして、個人の内なる本質であるアートマンは、このブラフマンと本来は一つであるとされる。この「梵我一如」の思想は、のちのヴェーダーンタ学派に受け継がれ、インド思想全体の土台となった。森羅万象が一つの源から生じるという見方は、仏教の縁起とは異なるが、いずれも「分けて見る」ことの錯覚を問い直す点で通じている。
cards.en: In the philosophy of the Upanishads, it is taught that at the root of all phenomena of the world lies a single reality called Brahman. And Ātman, the inner essence of the individual, is held to be originally one with this Brahman. This idea of the oneness of Brahman and Ātman was inherited by the later Vedānta school and became the foundation of Indian thought as a whole. The view that all things in the universe arise from one source differs from Buddhist dependent origination, but they share the point of questioning the illusion of "seeing things as separate."

According to one study, optimistic people tend to keep working at it doggedly even when they hit difficulties, and as a result their chance of success rises. Of course, averting your eyes from reality is a problem, but thinking "we won't know until we try" rather than "it's hopeless anyway" moves action one step ahead. A sense of competence, that I can do it, grows too, so I think the power to believe without grounds is also a fine talent.

words.defJa: 全体の構造から物事を捉える立場

cards.ja: 構造主義は、二十世紀の言語学者ソシュールの考え方を出発点とする、人文・社会科学の潮流である。ソシュールは、言葉の意味は、個々の単語がもつ中身ではなく、他の単語との違いの網の目によって決まると考えた。これは、それまでの言語観の根幹を揺さぶる発想だった。この見方は、人類学者レヴィ＝ストロースによって、神話や親族関係の分析に応用され、「人間は自分の意思で社会を作る」という前提を揺さぶった。日本でも、この見方が、文学や思想の分野で盛んに紹介された。
cards.en: Structuralism is a current in the humanities and social sciences that takes the thought of the twentieth-century linguist Saussure as its starting point. Saussure thought that the meaning of a word is determined not by the content each word holds but by a web of differences from other words. This was an idea that shook the foundation of the view of language up to then. This view was applied by the anthropologist Lévi-Strauss to the analysis of myths and kinship, shaking the premise that "humans build society by their own will." In Japan too, this view was actively introduced in the fields of literature and thought.

words.defJa: 歴史が記録され始めて以来

cards.ja: 有史以来、人類は、洪水や干ばつといった気候の変動に、繰り返し悩まされてきました。たとえば古代メソポタミアの文明は、塩害による農地の荒廃で衰えたとも考えられています。こうした歴史を学ぶ意味は、昔の出来事を暗記することではなく、現在の問題を、長い時間軸の中に置き直してみることにあります。すると、「未曾有の事態だ」という言い方が、実は過去の似た出来事を知らないだけなのかもしれないと気づくはずです。
cards.en: Since recorded history began, humankind has been repeatedly troubled by climate fluctuations such as floods and droughts. The civilization of ancient Mesopotamia, for example, is thought to have declined through the ruin of farmland caused by salt damage. The meaning of studying such history lies not in memorizing past events but in resetting present problems within a long time axis. Then you will surely notice that the phrase "an unprecedented situation" may simply reflect not knowing similar past events.

words.defJa: 支配などが正しいと認められる根拠

cards.ja: 権力が長く続くためには、力だけでなく、人々に受け入れられる正統性が必要である。王であれば神の意志や血筋、近代国家であれば選挙や法律が、その根拠として用いられてきた。しかし、その根拠は一度与えられれば永遠に続くものではなく、人々の信頼が揺らいだとき、あっけなく崩れる。歴史を振り返れば、栄枯盛衰を分けたのは、軍事力の差よりも、支配に対する納得の厚みの違いであったことが多い。
cards.en: For power to last long, it needs not only force but a legitimacy that people accept. For kings, the will of the gods or bloodline, and for modern states, elections and laws, have been used as its grounds. But once given, those grounds do not last forever, and they collapse easily when people's trust wavers. Looking back at history, what separated rise from fall was often not the difference in military strength but the difference in the depth of people's acceptance of the rule.

words.defJa: 要素を整理して全体像を作ること

cards.ja: 情報を構造化するとは、バラバラの要素を、分類し、関係づけて、全体像が見える形に整理することである。職場では、会議の議事録を、議題、決定事項、担当者に分けるだけでも、読み手の負担は大きく減る。逆に、構造のない長文は、書き手の頭の中の混乱を、そのまま読み手に手渡してしまう。近年は、生成AIに文章の要約や整理を任せる人も増えたが、何を核心として残すかの判断は、いまのところ人間の仕事である。
cards.en: To structure information is to classify scattered elements, link them to one another, and organize them into a form in which the whole picture can be seen. In the workplace, merely dividing meeting minutes into agenda, decisions, and persons in charge greatly reduces the reader's burden. Conversely, a long text with no structure hands the confusion in the writer's head directly to the reader. In recent years more people entrust summarizing and organizing text to generative AI, but the judgment of what to keep as the core is, for now, a human job.
